Fellow American,

Care, no matter what.

This is the motto of Planned Parenthood. While it sounds great on the surface, Planned Parenthood is lying to itself, to vulnerable women and young girls, and to the American people through manipulative and dangerously subtle language.

While they claim to provide healthcare services to women no matter who they are or where they live, abortion can never be healthcare. Further, while they claim to provide numerous services to women, 97.2% of Planned Parenthood's pregnancy resolution services are devoted to abortions, the purposeful ending of an unborn baby's life.

**[Does 97.2% of cases brought to Planned Parenthood that end in the death of an innocent child sound like"care" to you?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8587182e76f64d67a5e5bbd9cb84b784&_e=a3Kgn_k-x48ed72kIbjU7WDIAW2sIqPLaIKM4WBJflHdozixMaDYjcnpdFOs75Zy6lmPbvZL7PYm8SgNm0zSnTX0Ov6EAuVS8Pb6evWbAIS6DkJ8rdR8fYZiaVYMFv6Qb3icdYWTGdfgIsXs06zh_3Mw58WXM-zMtbD1TknxgFXicuim4PD_p4Wj2DxSgzKnh-sT2dqy8EJFfEDbCfN5E9NIn1Ag7flQRqzN2x1dBN-5a4uW3KWTOQ_9LIa1VyuYtAXsGwKOxkpRh9O-7tYmx1V7nPu4F04NAPJ5JucV942ugYXHXKCL_b7Axzm0XOCB7doJzazY3bJohQ5TBkPCO-Blp9sHN2bQKd8wh-zMcXhIJUw15QF4g_U1jyMJEaCkHgvr14grW046TaKm9Ezqw3a0WNc4QutJvsITUA-zP9c%3D)**

Planned Parenthood cares only about the business. It preys on the vulnerable, thrives on women's fear, and fuels itself on greed. When a woman arrives seeking answers to an unexpected pregnancy, the clock to gain a profit starts ticking. They will do whatever they can to make a woman agree to an abortion because each abortion completed is more profit in their pockets.

At SBA Pro-Life America, we are committed to stopping the manipulation and the gruesome deaths of innocent babies. In the last 10 years, Planned Parenthood has the lifeblood of 3.4 million babies on their hands.

**[We cannot be the only voice fighting for these precious children and exposing the lies of Planned Parenthood.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8587182e76f64d67a5e5bbd9cb84b784&_e=a3Kgn_k-x48ed72kIbjU7WDIAW2sIqPLaIKM4WBJflHdozixMaDYjcnpdFOs75Zy6lmPbvZL7PYm8SgNm0zSnTX0Ov6EAuVS8Pb6evWbAIS6DkJ8rdR8fYZiaVYMFv6Qb3icdYWTGdfgIsXs06zh_3Mw58WXM-zMtbD1TknxgFXicuim4PD_p4Wj2DxSgzKnh-sT2dqy8EJFfEDbCfN5E9NIn1Ag7flQRqzN2x1dBN-5a4uW3KWTOQ_9LIa1VyuYtAXsGwKOxkpRh9O-7tYmx5_iw0UAIelg8GKQz8w1zn3rgTGU691agf9cXhl8H3-5ZOPnL9tHhxqVHl67XyBDOHONuq51kSk7IE2Vrg__juwxvhuwCKKD_PrKHuwS3AUMvNJ0ms-BPmLBLDk7ee9VzdQjdaECK18grkpM7Zi8g4Y%3D)** Would you stand with us and commit to protecting women and unborn babies from the dangers of Planned Parenthood? By signing our pledge to stop Planned Parenthood, you are helping SBA Pro-Life America fight this "_David vs Goliath_ " battle.

Whether you know it or not, Planned Parenthood is impacting YOUR community and YOUR family by taking your hard-earned tax dollars to fund abortions and devaluing the unborn in our country.

**The lies, manipulation, and millions of deaths must come to an end now.**

name: America Fitzpatrick, LCV
subject: [Add Your Name:] Tell President Biden to Protect More Lands -- Designate New National Monuments Now
body:
Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding a judiciary that works for people and our planet.

Tell Congress to Rein in the Supreme Court

The Supreme Court just heard arguments in two key cases that threaten the EPA's and other agencies' ability to protect the people from big business.

Congress must stop MAGA judges' right-wing power grab. Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding that Congress rein in the Supreme Court and urgently prioritize confirming pro-environment, pro-democracy judges. https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.

Peter - the Supreme Court just heard arguments in two critical cases - Relentless, Inc. v. Department of Commerce and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo - that could gut the federal government's authority to enforce even the most basic environmental protections.

In both cases, corporate interests backed by big oil are suing in order to hamstring federal agencies' authority to protect people from powerful special interests. If these plaintiffs get their way, it would move authority over every area of public policy from public-interest agencies like the EPA to the MAGA-dominated federal courts.

In the last two years, extremist Justices on the Supreme Court have already severely limited the federal government's ability to regulate climate pollution from power plants, stripped Clean Water Act protections from most of the wetlands in the United States, and overturned Roe v. Wade. Some even take lavish gifts like private jet flights from the same billionaires bringing cases like this for them to rule on. Now, they're looking to overturn a bedrock doctrine of the American legal system in order to increase their own power.

Our planet and our communities are counting on us - we need your help to make our voices heard. We're asking 5,000 LCV members to take action before midnight tonight. Tell Congress to take action to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies with pro-environment, pro-democracy judges before it's too late >> https://links.messages.lcv.

These critical cases target what's called the Chevron Doctrine. This longstanding Supreme Court precedent says that when something is unclear in a federal law administered by an expert agency, such as the way the EPA administers the Clean Air Act, federal courts should defer to agency experts' reasonable interpretations of what the law means. The Chevron Doctrine is critical to enforcing the laws that protect our environment and our communities from pollution and other harms. It touches every issue, from climate to democracy to healthcare, reproductive rights, consumer protection, workers' rights, student debt, and so much more.

Put simply, if the Supreme Court rules in favor of the plaintiffs in Relentless and Loper Bright, it will gut the ability of federal agencies like the EPA to implement the laws Congress passes, transferring that power to unelected right-wing judges. And if Congress doesn't act, far-right judges will keep control of our Supreme Court, and keep rolling back our rights, for decades to come.

Congress must stop this MAGA power grab. We need lawmakers to pass the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. They must also pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act to ensure our nation's highest court doesn't have the lowest ethical standards. And we need the Senate to prioritize confirming President Biden's pro-environment, pro-democracy judicial nominees to every vacancy on the federal bench.

We can rein in corrupt MAGA judges, Peter, but it will only happen if our movement joins together to demand it. Please, take action right now. Tell Congress to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies. It only takes a moment to help us reach our goal >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_

Thank you for joining LCV's campaign for a democracy that works for our planet and for our communities.

Onward,

Doug Lindner
Senior Director of Judiciary & Democracy
League of Conservation Voters

body:
Friend,

Let’s dive into our findings so far of my latest Oregonians priority poll.

An overwhelming 98% of respondents share deep concerns about the current trajectory of our state under the influence of Portland Progressives and Tina Kotek. It's a stark reminder of the urgency for change.

96% agree that it's high time to hold Tina Kotek and her special interest allies accountable. It's a powerful statement of unity and purpose.

Turning to priorities, public safety emerges as the top concern for 90% of respondents, closely followed by education at 73%. These are not just numbers; they represent the very heartbeat of our communities.

And let's not ignore the fact that a resounding 96% of respondents expressed dissatisfaction with the state government's performance in addressing these pressing issues. This dissatisfaction is a catalyst for action.

While we're nearing our goal of 500 responses, we're close but not there yet. I'm reaching out to you, as someone deeply committed to our community's well-being, to help spread the word. Christine

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: major update!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I have some urgent news for you that will have a major impact this November!

On Monday, the Florida Supreme Court issued a HUGE discission on a case involving _Students for Life Action’s_ hard fought _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law!_

**__The good news_?_ ➔** The state’s previous _15 Week Abortion Prevention Act_ was upheld, which means our _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law_ that will save preborn babies with a heartbeat _(the universal sign of Life)_ can now go in effect!

**__The bad news_?_ ➔** The Florida Supreme Court also ruled that a radical and intentionally confusing Abortion Ballot Initiative, which will legalize abortion “before viability” _(practically every abortion),_ will be on the ballot this November.

Pro-Life Friend, if this dangerous Ballot Initiative is passed, our Heartbeat Law will be WIPED OUT and abortion would be allowed in the Sunshine State up until around 24 weeks!

**_THIS IS INSANE!_**

We must act NOW!

**[That’s why I’m calling on you, Pro-Life Friend,_and other generous pro-lifers like you,_ to help _Students for Life Action_ send immediate aid to our Election Programs in Florida so we can fight this Ballot Initiative](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suthta-duchtdja-y/)!**

Your generous contribution will help us:

**➣** Send student canvassers to key districts to knock on doors and gauge voters;
**➣** Engage in other forms of voter outreach such as calling, texting, and emailing campaigns;
**➣** Pay for election materials used to educate voters and convert pro-abortion/on-the-fence voters to the Pro-Life Movement; and
**➣** Get out the pro-life vote by committing both current and new pro-life voters to get to the polls and vote against this sinister Ballot Initiative.
And with _Students for Life Action_ deploying our student activists to Florida next Saturday, April 13th, we’ll need as many pro-lifers as possible to chip in to help us make the impact we need!

**[Right now, a contribution of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 will be critical to defeating this sinister Ballot Initiative in November – _so please be as generous as you can_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suthta-duchtdja-j/) _!_**

Pro-Life Friend, without _Students for Life Action’s_ efforts, Florida wouldn’t have a Heartbeat Law in the first place . . .

But, if the Abortion Lobby’s insane Ballot Initiative passes in November, then you and I can kiss Florida’s Heartbeat Law goodbye!

The stakes just got raised to a new high, as millions of preborn lives are now on the line in the Sunshine State!

We can’t afford to let these little preborn boys and girls down.

**_Their future is now in our hands!_**

So, that’s why I need you to take **_IMMEDIATE_** action!

**[Help me double down on all _Students for Life Action’s_ Election Programs with the most generous contribution you can give right now](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suthta-duchtdja-i/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Organizing against SB4 today and every day / Estamos organizando contra SB4 hoy y todos los días
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
RSVP:
San Antonio "Know Your Rights" event on SB4 on April 27
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20SA%20training.jpg]
SB4 [https://www.keranews.org/texas-news/2024-04-02/texas-immigration-enforcement-bill-sb4-is-back-in-federal-appeals-court-wednesday] is a racist law that is wholly rooted in white supremacy. This anti-immigrant law will effectively give license to local law enforcement to criminalize and incarcerate Black and Latino immigrants.
It’s more important now than ever to ensure that we are all properly equipped with the necessary knowledge to protect ourselves against dangerous legislation. TOP will host a “Know Your Rights” training in San Antonio at the Westfall Branch Library on April 27 from 12:30 - 2:30 p.m.
Click here to RSVP and for more information! [https://secure.everyaction.com/T-9x9P2RKE2ScFBfgD7dkQ2]
Crystal Mason's Conviction is Overturned
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Crystal%20Mason.png]
Crystal Mason’s conviction for casting a provisional ballot on the 2016 election has been overturned. [https://www.npr.org/2024/03/29/1241615870/crystal-mason-texas-voting-acquitted]
But let’s not overlook the absurdity of this situation. Mason was sentenced to five years in prison for an honest mistake, while white-collar criminals roam free, peddling influence and subverting democracy without consequence.
It’s ridiculous that Mason was given a five-year prison sentence for casting a provisional ballot while on supervised release. This injustice underscores how Texas GOP officials’ efforts to suppress votes and claim widespread voter fraud stem from their mission to intimidate voters of color – and their belief in The Big Lie [https://protectdemocracy.org/work/what-is-the-big-lie/] reinforces this.
Right-wing extremists know they can only win elections when they suppress our votes, and TOP is committed as ever to mobilizing Black and Latino voters to make our voices heard at the ballot box each and every election cycle.
No matter age, race, gender, or background, ALL Texas voters deserve to have their voice heard and their ballot counted.
Apply to join Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/We%20are%20hiring%20-%20English.png]
If you or someone you know cares deeply about social justice and transforming our state so Black and Latino Texans have the political power they deserve, then check out TOP’s current job openings [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/] . Don't hesitate to connect us to any talented and passionate community members you may have in mind.
Feel free to email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions or to apply.
TOP Tip: Change your Instagram settings to include political posts
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Instagram%20settings.png]
Instagram has started an automatic clamp down on the amount of political content appearing in its users’ feeds, but there is a relatively quick and easy way to turn off the controls [https://apnews.com/article/instagram-political-content-controls-no-limits-tech-tip-38261d957f0c56893de6135a13ac442e] if you don’t want to keep the limitations in place.
Español
Confirme su asistencia:
Evento "Conozca sus derechos" en San Antonio sobre SB4 el 27 de abril
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20SA%20training.jpg]
La SB4 [https://www.univision.com/local/houston-kxln/corte-de-apelaciones-del-quinto-circuito-escucho-argumentos-sobre-la-ley-sb-4-de-texas-video] es una ley racista que está totalmente arraigada en la supremacía blanca. Esta ley antiinmigrante efectivamente otorgará licencia a las autoridades locales para criminalizar y encarcelar a inmigrantes negros y latinos.
Ahora es más importante que nunca garantizar que todos estemos adecuadamente equipados con los conocimientos necesarios para protegernos contra leyes peligrosas. TOP organizará una capacitación “Conozca sus derechos” en el condado de Bexar en la biblioteca sucursal de Westfall el 27 de abril de 12:30 a 2:30 p.m.
¡Haga clic aquí para confirmar su asistencia y obtener más información! [https://secure.everyaction.com/T-9x9P2RKE2ScFBfgD7dkQ2]
Se anula la condena penal de Crystal Mason
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Crystal%20Mason.png]
La condena penal de Crystal Mason por emitir un voto provisional en las elecciones de 2016 ha sido anulada. [https://www.npr.org/2024/03/29/1241615870/crystal-mason-texas-voting-acquitted]
Pero no pasemos por alto lo absurdo de esta situación. Mason fue sentenciado a cinco años de prisión por un error honesto, mientras que los delincuentes de cuello blanco deambulan libremente, traficando influencias y subvirtiendo la democracia sin consecuencias.
Es ridículo que a Mason le dieran una sentencia de cinco años de prisión por emitir un voto provisional mientras se encontraba en libertad supervisada.
Esta injusticia subraya cómo los esfuerzos de los funcionarios republicanos de Texas por suprimir votos y denunciar un fraude electoral generalizado se derivan de su misión de intimidar a los votantes de color, y su creencia en La Gran Mentira [https://protectdemocracy.org/work/what-is-the-big-lie/] refuerza esto.
Los extremistas de derecha saben que sólo pueden ganar elecciones si suprimen nuestros votos, y TOP está comprometido, como siempre, a movilizar a los votantes negros y latinos para que nuestras voces se escuchen en las urnas en todos y cada uno de los ciclos electorales.
No importa la edad, raza, género u origen, TODOS los votantes de Texas merecen que se escuche su voz y se cuente su boleta.
Consejos de TOP: Cambie su configuración de Instagram para incluir contenido político
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Spanish%20-%20we%20are%20hiring.png]
Si usted o alguien que conoce se preocupa profundamente por la justicia social y por transformar nuestro estado para que los tejanos negros y latinos tengan el poder político que merecen, consulte las vacantes laborales actuales de TOP. No dude en conectarnos con cualquier miembro talentoso y apasionado de la comunidad que pueda tener en mente.
No dude en enviar un correo electrónico a recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] si tiene alguna pregunta o para postularse.
Consejos de TOP: Cambie su configuración de Instagram para incluir contenido político
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Instagram%20settings.png]
Instagram ha iniciado una restricción automática de la cantidad de contenido político que aparece en la plataforma, pero existe una manera rápida y fácil de desactivar los controles [https://apnews.com/article/instagram-political-content-controls-no-limits-tech-tip-38261d957f0c56893de6135a13ac442e] si no desea esas limitaciones de contenido.

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: How often do you think about the Roman Republic?
body:
“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”

| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32615%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oEbbSvDNoXAHUqd8WHOn3g&sysid=1)
---
| |
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32616%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KarAiOeJNWUni3Y9japGug&sysid=1) Dear Friend,

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic” when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,” **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32617%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=W7Y7%2bYslTTZfJ4fEd4WwsA&sysid=1)

By studying ancient Rome, you’ll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

| | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrs16a5qrgrmrapgmtdh9qvp7mevmmrltn7mbnh0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c9h62o75c1h2bs)

| |
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbqub6826fts2r2o8u4ofhlgckqqg3viqbg5jtg0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c9h62o75c1h2bs) Dear Friend,

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z442h639p9u177g90efob3nia6gebikdve3e0lno_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c9h62o75c1h2bs)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

However, Maricopa County maintains unstaffed, unsupervised ballot drop boxes, facilitating illegal ballot harvesting**_ For many years now, the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors and the County Recorder have consistently failed to lawfully administer elections. We believe these individuals are fully aware of their election law violations.**Make no mistake:** Our lawsuit has been filed to prevent the November 5, 2024, election from being tainted with the same mistakes and maladministration that occurred during the 2020 and 2022 elections and to prevent election interference from occurring._Thank you for your support of our mission and historic legal actions here!_[_**_PLEASE RUSH SUPPORT HERE >>_**_](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5v8gDZ6bpE2SRKqZcH-x_Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn8RKyP0TWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9hbWVyaWNhLWZpcnN0LWxlZ2FsLWZvdW5kYXRpb24vbWFyaWNvcGEtY291bnR5LWxhd3N1aXQtcG9wLWE_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1SZXZTaGFyZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249QUZMX01DQVotUG9wQV8yMDI0MDIxMiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVtYWlsJnV0bV90Yz1DQi0yMDI0MDQwNCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1NQ0FaLVBvcEEmdXRtX2FnZW5jeT1QR1cDc3BjQgpmBA93DmZ17xajUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)_** **_ Stephen Miller _President, America First Legal _

## Taiwan Earthquake Kills 9, Injures 950
Taiwan was hit by the strongest earthquake to shake the island in 25 years, killing nine people, injuring 900, and leaving a bus filled with 50 people still missing. [Video, maps, and photos are here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuxCAQBb8GOluwrMEUFGmuu7QprcVe7oiwOdnorPx95NTR695II83XfbpTLnl7fNLKoaU60dzymyfssAOcUC4hMQMbyUE7DWCc80Y-Aw44KI6aBrCEYwSKTmvtE48RdFIyB1CA6pofLEBPXitrZrYJFxrJCFS85Fb3_rvmrT05lZ_65r2f6ypLeLb2OoT5EHATcDvPs49xvpiA28bncZ11L0tHR6bOjk57763cw_I6cyn5sE6geqyUy5-x_Zf3GwAA___2Hk8X) The earthquake measured [7.4 on the Richter scale](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uhDAQBOCnMZ2RWfv4KVykobu0KdEeXmATg4nZO5S3j0gdTTfTfJqP-3BHjrzN77iSlykNOAq_aHDaaXCDK4KfiIBsQb5qKgDbNJ0tFg_YhWBc86iCs7dH15rWNTW1XQDrbiEU7MGAM1e6Ww1QYleZ2o5UTy5gi1Y5Q4El5fIz8SYLTfEnvSiXY1qL6BeR_VD2TUGvoD_Ps8z0FMrHtV9NyjEo6PFg1DuOPPGooD8kp23WDegV543lGUgTZlm-n_hFemE5tCDvxPryaeO0sQr6IvuwnxwjH3WjnJlX5PhHkf9--Q0AAP__g4tjbQ) and badly damaged several buildings when it struck just off the east coast at about 8 a.m. local time. Over 50 aftershocks were recorded as rescue efforts were underway for over 100 people trapped in collapsed tunnels and on mountainous roads. [One video of a man in a rooftop pool](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuhDAQBb_G7kBmbWxcuEhDd2lTogWvj40MPoF1KH8fkTp63RtppPl6TA_kzPvzEzcKNZUJl8pvmkxjGjCTkTEkIiAtKXSuA9DOeS3XoOI8eBwGSzFRdD160jB7m2zqet0ryQEUGHXP9xagRd8pqxeyyUQcUAujKHItR_tdeK8rpfxT3nS0S9lkDmutr1PoDwGjgPG6rnael5sJGHe6zvssR44NnoyNHRz01ml5hPi6OGc-rRNGPTfk_Ges_-X9BgAA__9gNU-W) during the quake gives an idea of the building's swaying.
## Shoppers Skeptical of Electric Car Offerings
A new survey by auto specialist Edmunds reveals a significant disconnect between current [electric cars on the market](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAUhH8N3rDwgxh7YOjClq4drRd4JFTYWEBi5d9XzlyddLecdKfv57pcMaa43b9xJdNCXtC1-KJFccVBLarzJhAByY7MoAcAqfUsu4cRIWivNY3iNgmlvLxoPxHe3EAXPYepiwYEKHFqvowAPc6DGKWjMSiPE0qmBPnYcul_c9zag0J65xeV3uW1S-bR2l6Z_GJgGdjjOPpnxZY9vs8CA1tbLm8Gds0bnemwVAb2XGVgxcckA0uJXCvRcYeF04tXTFR5Tc915y5v9blS4XfcGVgth2nQQguhGdiuGL8fMaVYR82UuK8Y0-dd-w_VXwAAAP__q3dnyg) and the features shoppers actually want. Edmunds reported [most shoppers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn-NvWFhIDgeGLpkS9eO1hnO8bVgIriE9t9X6Vx9yye95el9XJcrUKTj9g4JHW95Ac_0xMUII5RZTB_chqhQ9-jGaVRKT9Os-93Z0YDcpDyfLJwmCeu8BrvO2usVtQ-qJ6ekMvK1-WSVGmAepdUe7WYCnEF3RmIgzmX4zHTwjlv8yU8sg8-pj25nvtdOv3Xq0qlLa23AkB5HqC_eqYuHIg5s9XXzUR8Ji8DvO3oGpnxUkTeBzyp8hLqLRryLBOULWRSESExYh51T7IsL90YxUrVTZ-QtAcU_B_4vyG8AAAD__-deZKE) are looking for prices below $40,000, for cars and SUVs, not trucks, and for a vehicle with at least a 200-mile range. The current EV market contains only four cars under $40,000 and four truck models, with three more planned. On the bright side for EV makers, the 200-mile range is a near-standard feature amongst all available vehicles. The market share of EVs increased to 6.9% in 2023, up from 5.2% in 2022, [but that rate is expected to slow](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL8GOiNYbyAUFGnoLm1KtMHrYxPbnOy9Q_f3EUkbjfSq0dNoPi7LhSRIur5T5En9vtCq8uAFDRrABWs3eWZgW_PUDR2AHYbR1tsE3q6EHkfreB09kMVxwBYcM3Y49rVM0AK2Z8aXHqChsWt7u3Lv0dEr2QpbdqJ7br52SbqxD8_9wblZ91iHaVO9lcq-VTBXMB_H0dBd98yR8jerpOvZq2CmfCJReBYpFczs4j25YrycjFIi6bqZT9aDOZn1XnSPnM1BSYuh5Myf0WSmICp8Suo8udshIUjphwrbayQJv8P0v5d-AgAA__-g8Gww) with consumers critical of current EV prices, body type, and range.
## Poll: Americans Agree on Core Values
Despite deep political polarization, [Americans share](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O4yAURp8Gd0Tk8hcXFNu4y7ZbWnfhYjPiJ8LEUd5-lKlHX_lJ50jn3329Y8qpbn-xkBuxrehHOmlVXHFQq5qCi0RAciJ3tVcAae0sp93FEILQFMMt6P8CrNQ6GqPlzaKYvYcpORCgxGezNgAXnK_CSE8mqoA3lEwJCmm0fvlqqY6dYn63k_rFtzJlt4_xOJj8w2BhsIyd9pTz52Ow7K1QpdfBYPFYHpi2ymBR2oKQhld68ePZT3pz3DpRoTp4acfgvnXiWKgnj5WfmJ_0YUzdhccr5ZwOY5kSW8H0o5rGb02-AwAA__96tGOi) many core beliefs, according to a new poll released by the Associated Press and NORC Center for Public Affairs Research. A majority of all Americans, about 9 in 10, believed that the right to vote, equal protection under the law, and privacy were very important. Results also indicated that 84% of U.S. adults viewed the freedom of religion as a key principle. While the overall data showed "only small variances between Republicans and Democrats," a large gap remained between the parties over one issue: Gun ownership. Sixty percent of Republicans said it was extremely important versus only 19% of Democrats. You can [see the full survey here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOwyAQRL_G7ohgAQMFxTXpcu2V1hqWmBM2FkaJ8venpD5NNTPN0_u5zTfMJe_3b9zI91RnDD0_aFZMMVCzGqNPREByJC-MAJDGODmuPtrFiaiNWUA656wVS4qJG3CUKGEcswcOir_j9ARwQSf4JANNSUW0KAfFKeZe2-W35r2vlMqrPqhdQt3G4tfej3OQXwNcB7jisdPzfF_v0noOhT4zO2opLNJWQ8PwYi3f136y1Ihi3U5GhULPdWeL4MpENKC1ICG1Viiddsoa0sIKHJuPxzOXks_JDIrfN8zlw9L_E_MXAAD__05MY1Y).

# Great Ways to Support Mark
---
Hello Peter,
Here are eight great and simple ways to support Mark.
1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail.
2. Follow Mark on Facebook. Click here to go to our campaign page: [Facebook](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00150mv97UmtSl2UmF46RfNIwAWNv_u_psAnG4f_BhbnAQ9PyhEKUVHFSjJfIBzPHyaPVYl162sh7wbn4A907-K3AIXgfhUbFCm6kLxOcvc90YyZsvMb4A-0mvY1DbmA0jBSlNN6-6-gA6Kz5zGaAKjq2KTuQAVAc3A8yF8Pwv8YOo=&c=5Z8JxxzKJLf0vweP7wQhHkq8KulecRRKE64s6_6xPuvynA5mtijYTg==&ch=2MJwQXcZ8x806AnGGQgCoLl9BsNXr3PCAv7pJw27p3EEymcvbMR73g==). When you like a post, you can share it with others by simply hitting the "share" button.
3. Host a Meet & Greet. This is the secret behind Mark's success. Last time, he won the Primary election without advertising - it was all word-of-mouth and grassroots-driven. It is not difficult to host a Meet & Greet. Invite some friends and neighbors over to your house or another meeting place. Mark will come to introduce himself and answer questions. You can sign up for a Meet & Greet at this link: [https://calendly.com/robertson-for-congress/meet-and-greet](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00150mv97UmtSl2UmF46RfNIwAWNv_u_psAnG4f_BhbnAQ9PyhEKUVHFazqDSPNHlErUhceAfj3oMheg7K-xJXEKiACDdpOEO96ZDm9IH3nyMRwFxvoZ1LvI_JF_sdPKzqGqkbrhAlUgg55Ls_9FbluDokeygLtXC_6VntSBTme3dWRdWiV1WWcK-WJ98nLn8dbN-CruD86DWU=&c=5Z8JxxzKJLf0vweP7wQhHkq8KulecRRKE64s6_6xPuvynA5mtijYTg==&ch=2MJwQXcZ8x806AnGGQgCoLl9BsNXr3PCAv7pJw27p3EEymcvbMR73g==)
4. Install a Yard Sign. Enthusiastic volunteers will install a sign in your yard. Call or text this number and leave a message with your address: (818) 932-8050.
5. Invite Mark as a Speaker. If you belong to a group (Book Club, for example), invite Mark to drop by for a few minutes to introduce himself and answer questions. Call or text this number to check his schedule: (702) 379-5704.
6. Knock on Doors. We'll provide you with a list of registered voters in your area so you can leave some literature at their front door. If you feel comfortable, you could ring the doorbell and tell them about Mark. Call or text Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050

You can donate to the campaign at this link: [https://secure.anedot.com/robertson-for-congress/2024-launch](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00150mv97UmtSl2UmF46RfNIwAWNv_u_psAnG4f_BhbnAQ9PyhEKUVHFZokzfJn55hpO8n3wu4u_ehuTYFZLFI6Rk3P21YmGC7GmFFCq1KeddU0XKlCF5VlnP4OlILl0FbX42KbOiY-Fi8088FQnZFSiBEeh1L2GqJbcyNFZuc7cu659v2dOigxFuCFJGMKLS36eNza8nPDd8w=&c=5Z8JxxzKJLf0vweP7wQhHkq8KulecRRKE64s6_6xPuvynA5mtijYTg==&ch=2MJwQXcZ8x806AnGGQgCoLl9BsNXr3PCAv7pJw27p3EEymcvbMR73g==)

subject: Have you heard what white liberals think of Black Americans?

body:
|

| |
---
| |
---
Dear Mr. Willis,
_" They're not aware."_
_" They're not informed."_
_" They don't have a knowledge of how [the internet] works."_
These are the kinds of racist, ignorant things you hear from liberals on college campuses.
_But don 't take my word for it..._
Ami Horowitz, a conservative film maker, took his camera to the University of California in Berkely and asked students whether they thought voter ID laws were racist and why.
The students at Berkely and other Left-wing campuses across the nation think that Black Americans are helpless.
They don't realize that we're self-reliant, fiercely independent, and love our country.
But they try to victimize us and blame our "woes" on "racist" Republicans and the equally "racist" Republican Party.
And they're infecting the next generation of young Americans with that same kind of garbage, perpetuating their heinous lies.
So what did Ami do after speaking to the students in California?
He traveled to Harlem, in New York City, and asked the black residents there to respond to what the students said.
You have to see it for yourself!
[](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=145316692&msgid=1215427&act=403D&c=632087&pid=35056841&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.ifr-ors.com%2FBAF%2F2024%2FEA%2F04%2Findex.php%3Finfo%3D2024EA0402&cf=48812&v=7741293036f204dc37ff6157b1a7be606c9bceb073805b1fb791a1a2cb329f1c)
---
##### [Click here](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=145316692&msgid=1215427&act=403D&c=632087&pid=35056841&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.ifr-ors.com%2FBAF%2F2024%2FEA%2F04%2Findex.php%3Finfo%3D2024EA0402&cf=48812&v=7741293036f204dc37ff6157b1a7be606c9bceb073805b1fb791a1a2cb329f1c) or above to watch the video!
Mr. Willis, it's unbelievable how ignorant so many on the Left are when it comes to understanding black men and women...
But this is what they do.
They feed their lies to young students at brainwashing facilities they call "Universities" to the point where these students' minds are poisoned by the time they get their diplomas.
| [Help bring more Black Americans to the Republican Party](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=145316692&msgid=1215427&act=403D&c=632087&pid=35056841&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.ifr-ors.com%2FBAF%2F2024%2FEA%2F04%2Findex.php%3Finfo%3D2024EA0402&cf=48812&v=7741293036f204dc37ff6157b1a7be606c9bceb073805b1fb791a1a2cb329f1c)
---
Do you know that one of those students whose mind was poisoned was Justice Clarence Thomas?
That's right.
One of the most famous jurists on the Supreme Court - a Conservative, Black graduate of Yale - Justice Clarence Thomas - bought into Democrat ideology as a young undergrad student.
---
_" We were all Democrats for whatever reason, even though the Republican Party was the anti-slavery party... I was giving up on the very things that had been the guiding lights in my life... For the first time in my life, racism and race explained everything. It became, sort of, the substitute religion."_
But, after participating in riot at Harvard University in protest of the Vietnam War, Clarence Thomas saw firsthand how left-wing radicalism led to violence, confusion, and anger.
He didn't feel right about it.
_" I remember standing right in front of the chapel outside and I asked God, 'If you take anger out of my heart, I'll never hate again.' And that was the beginning of the slow return to where I started."_
And you know the rest of the story. He became one of the greatest justices we've ever had on the Supreme Court!

We at America First Legal have just filed an **absolutely momentous** lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona’s election administration laws. name: Rebecca Hardy
subject: YOU Made This Possible!
body:
| |
---
| [View in browser](https://click.mlflow.com/link/c/YT0yNDUwNzU1MjQxODQzMzY2Mjc0JmM9cjdoNCZlPTAmYj0xMTI3MjcyNDg2JmQ9ejhkOGs2cQ==.sL2gl3jTjbEOdlIROokLgVA8wI_Lz6yzoYcwGfxYfVA)
| | |
---
|
---
---
| |
---
| Peter, A common question we hear at TFVC: “So what does TFVC actually DO?” We exist to protect vaccine choice and medical privacy, but we act this out in many different ways! TFVC may be best known for its work in the state capitol: every other year, the Texas state legislature meets for five months beginning in January. Before the session we write legislation to advance our medical rights and during the session we spend hundreds of hours in Austin working with legislators to pass those bills.
Another huge part of our operation at the capitol is _killing_ the bad bills. Dozens of bills that would threaten your vaccine choice are filed every session. As soon as we find one of these bills, we educate voters all over the state and help them contact their elected officials to fight against these bills. **Because of the activism of thousands of Texans,****each and every bill TFVC has opposed has been stopped from becoming law!**

---
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| Educating about our medical rights and helping Texans stand up for themselves and their families is so rewarding! Did you know Texas allows for multiple vaccine exemptions for children? At TFVC, we field dozens of calls from parents with questions about this process. We help with these exemptions at _no cost_ to the family in need. We have also been working to help Texans navigate vaccine mandates from COVID-19 policies - helping people keep their jobs and their paycheck!
People like you often look to TFVC for information about where candidates stand on the issue of vaccine choice. We help educate Texans on the good and bad guys. **And we are proudly non-partisan.**

---
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| Protecting vaccine choice and medical privacy is **critical** to our rights as free Texans. We are blessed to work with Texans everyday on matters that affect our rights in every way. YOU should call the shots!

---
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| Gratefully,
---
| Rebecca Hardy

---
President, Texans for Vaccine Choice

body:
| | | | |
---
| | |
# [Sign: Remove Judge Aileen Cannon from the Trump Case for Bias and Incompetence](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td390260a-82d2-47e6-8c71-0587d38b43cb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2e1cbeb9-31da-4593-8feb-6c2e5da19913/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Aileen Cannon, the judge in the Trump documents case, has shown herself to be wildly biased and jaw-droppingly incompetent -- and now special counsel Jack Smith has taken the [first step](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc1c8be98-4a07-4899-8cec-79e578cf3998/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) on the path to removing and replacing her. [**Show your support: Add your name, and demand that Judge Cannon be removed NOW.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7cea0207-85b6-4bac-8373-2402338fdb6f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Cannon, a Trump-appointee, has been bending over backwards to help Trump. She has delayed the trial repeatedly for no good reason, and now is [proposing](https://default.salsalabs.org/T404d0ac6-b483-4a5a-aa15-e076dbf3f88e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) that jurors could consider the documents Trump stole to be his personal property. Jack Smith has hit back hard with a filing against this proposal, and looks poised to follow up with a call for her removal. This is arguably the most important of all the Trump cases, and we can't have it controlled by someone in Trump's back pocket. She needs to go, and the trial needs to proceed as soon as possible. [**Add your name, and demand that Judge Cannon be removed NOW.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T39b93fab-08da-4216-8c17-ab488931a3aa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---

Bitcoin, the world's first and most popular cryptocurrency, is set to undergo its third halving event later this month. This event has significant implications for Bitcoin's future, including its price, mining profitability, and overall network security.
**What is Bitcoin Halving?**
Bitcoin halving is a pre-programmed event that occurs roughly every four years, reducing the rate at which new Bitcoins are created. The event cuts the Bitcoin rewards paid to miners in half, thereby reducing the number of new Bitcoins entering circulation. The first halving occurred in November 2012, when the block reward was reduced from 50 BTC to 25 BTC. The second halving took place in July 2016, cutting the reward to 12.5 BTC. The upcoming halving in April 2024 will reduce the reward to 6.25 BTC.
**Why Does Bitcoin Halving Happen?**
Halving is a key feature of Bitcoin's design, which ensures that the total supply of Bitcoin remains limited. There will only ever be 21 million Bitcoins, and the halving mechanism is designed to control the rate at which new Bitcoins are introduced into the market. This scarcity mechanism is similar to gold mining, where the supply of gold increases at a decreasing rate over time. By reducing the block reward, Bitcoin's creators aimed to create a deflationary currency that would become more valuable over time as demand increases.
**Implications of Bitcoin Halving:**
1. Price Volatility: Historically, Bitcoin's price has experienced significant volatility leading up to and following a halving event. As the block reward is reduced, the cost of producing new Bitcoins increases, making it more expensive for miners to continue their operations. This can lead to a decrease in the supply of new Bitcoins entering the market, potentially driving up the price due to increased scarcity.
2. Mining Profitability: As the block reward decreases, miners may find it less profitable to continue mining Bitcoin. However, if the price of Bitcoin increases following the halving event, it could offset the reduced block reward and maintain mining profitability. Some miners may choose to upgrade their equipment or join mining pools to remain competitive.
3. Network Security: The security of the Bitcoin network is maintained by a distributed network of miners who validate transactions and secure the blockchain. A decrease in mining profitability could lead to a reduction in the number of miners securing the network, potentially making it more vulnerable to attacks. However, if the price of Bitcoin increases following the halving, it could incentivize more miners to join the network, maintaining or even increasing its security.
4. Investment Value: Investors often view Bitcoin halving as a bullish event, as it reduces the rate at which new Bitcoins enter the market, potentially increasing the value of existing Bitcoin holdings. However, the impact of halving on Bitcoin's price is not guaranteed, and other factors such as market sentiment, global economic conditions, and regulatory changes can also influence its value.

Bitcoin halving is a significant event that occurs every four years, reducing the rate at which new Bitcoins are created and impacting various aspects of the cryptocurrency ecosystem. As the third halving approaches this month, it is essential for investors, miners, and users to understand its implications and prepare for potential changes in Bitcoin's price, mining profitability, and network security. While the exact effects of the halving on Bitcoin's future are uncertain, it remains a crucial event that shapes the cryptocurrency's long-term value and sustainability.

Hi Friend Unknown,We’re less than one month away from the April 23rd presidential primary election in the Commonwealth. In this week’s roundup, we’ve compiled resources, upcoming events, important dates, and news you can use to stay informed, and ready to VOTE!
|
---
# We’re Hiring!
The New Pennsylvania Project is currently hiring! Please see our open positions below:
* [Director of Strategic Communications](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=83fa7a7813&e=95417d7e87)
* [Regional Organizing Director: Chester & Delaware Counties](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=077b3797c0&e=95417d7e87)
* [Regional Organizing Director: Bucks County](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=ffd4efb8a6&e=95417d7e87)
* [Regional Organizing Director: Philadelphia](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=70e4e0e520&e=95417d7e87)
* [Community Engagement Associates (Lehigh Valley and Chester/Delaware Counties)](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=73b2467f1a&e=95417d7e87)
* [Part-time Education & Engagement Associates (Lehigh Valley and Chester/Delaware Counties) via affiliated organization New PA Project Education Fund](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=b42917d04c&e=95417d7e87)

Interested in joining Team NPP? Please email your resume to [jobs@newpaproject.org](mailto:jobs@newpaproject.org) and provide the position you are applying for in the subject line.

# NPP In The News
**When it Comes to Our Freedom to Vote, the Two Parties Are Not the Same** “Leading an organization with a primary focus of expanding democracy by expanding the electorate – through voter registration, civic engagement, and education – we frequently hear: _‘I’m not interested in voting. My vote doesn’t matter. Nothing changes. The two parties are the same.’_ The two major political parties in Pennsylvania are not the same. When it comes to advocating for our freedom to vote, legislating for enhanced accessibility to the ballot, and more convenient voting options for the electorate, it’s not even close.”
Read the full op-ed by Kadida Kenner, CEO of New Pennsylvania Project in the [Bucks County Beacon.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=8118814b81&e=95417d7e87)**
Kenyatta Attacks DeFoor, Ignores Pinsley in Auditor General Town Hall** Democratic candidates for auditor general, state Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta, and Lehigh County Controller Mark Pinsley participated separately in a Zoom town hall sponsored by New Pennsylvania Project, a voting rights group. Read the full article in [The Delaware Valley Journal](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=48b789c1c0&e=95417d7e87).**
Pa. House Republicans seek to force vote on tougher voter ID law** “This is their (Republicans’) attempt to stop Black and Brown folks, young voters and immigrant communities from having more convenient access to ballots and having their voices heard on Election Day,” NPP’s Kadida Kenner told [LancasterOnline](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=29bb44f503&e=95417d7e87).

Kenner said House Republicans’ announcement Monday was a “tit for tat” response to Democratic House Speaker Joanna McClinton, of Philadelphia, who [last week](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=d64b680394&e=95417d7e87) said she plans to advance legislation to expand early voting and same-day voter registration. Read the full article [here](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=7e7fcd5c0e&e=95417d7e87).
# Social of the Week
Over the weekend, we went to Lehigh Valley to meet folks where they are and provide civic education about elections and the courts at an Easter Egg Hunt.
| | | | [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6d4e1b5d5d&e=95417d7e87)| [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=aadbdbf795&e=95417d7e87)| [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=07fcee76bc&e=95417d7e87)
---|---|---
|
---
# News You Can Use
**Pennsylvania’s primary election is at the start of Passover. Why some Jewish voters feel disenfranchised** After a series of unsuccessful attempts to change the date of Pennsylvania’s primary election, voting will take place April 23, [The Morning Call](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=411f7ef2d2&e=95417d7e87) reports.

**How a SCOTUS ruling on mifepristone might disrupt abortion care in Pa.** More than half of abortions in Pennsylvania are medication abortions that use a two-pill regimen. Pennsylvania is one of the states where patients can get a medication abortion via telehealth appointment, which means they don't have to travel as far to receive care, [WESA](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=aa11d23595&e=95417d7e87) reports.

**Can Democrats flip the Pennsylvania Senate for a trifecta?** In 2022, Democrats regained control of the Pennsylvania House, a razor-thin majority that has survived several special elections since. Now, the party is eyeing the tantalizingly close margin in the state Senate, where Republicans hold 28 seats, and Democrats hold 22, the [Penn Capital Star](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6597f95830&e=95417d7e87) reports.

**Voter registration, mail-in voting: Pennsylvania deadlines to know ahead of the April 23 primary** Pennsylvania’s primary election is a month away, and there are several deadlines voters should know, according to [Penn Capital Star](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=bba56e1834&e=95417d7e87).

**Voter Registration by Congressional District** Courtesy of the Pennsylvania Department of State, here is the data for registered voters in the Commonwealth by congressional district. ([Politics PA](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=38313fb736&e=95417d7e87))

**Republicans pushing to embrace mail-in voting encounter widespread resistance** Trump's repeated attacks on mail-in voting have made it tougher for Republicans who see a desperate need for the GOP to encourage more ways to cast ballots, [NBC News](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6cdbdec39e&e=95417d7e87) reports.
|
---
# Upcoming Events
**Primary Colors of Democracy**
Join Northampton Community College Student Life on Thursday, April 18 for a nonpartisan panel on the current state of U.S. Democracy before we head into the April 23rd presidential primary. Kadida Kenner, CEO of New Pennsylvania Project will be a featured panelist. **Date** : Thursday, April 18, 2024
**Time** : 11:00 a.m.
**Where** : Northampton Community College, 3835 Green Pond Road, Bethlehem PA 18020
|
---
# 2024 Important Primary Election Dates
**April 8:** Last day to register to vote in the primary election [vote.pa.gov/register](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=61a89dc132&e=95417d7e87)**April 16:** Last day to apply for a mail ballot [vote.pa.gov/applymailballot](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=f2fa34a9ca&e=95417d7e87) **April 23** : Completed mail ballots must be received by 8:00 p.m. [vote.pa.gov/county](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=52444ae477&e=95417d7e87)**April 23:** Election Day. Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.[vote.pa.gov/polls](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=7ba9a49962&e=95417d7e87)
# Help Us Expand The Electorate
**We're on a mission to register new voters in the Commonwealth and expand the electorate.**
**Help us prepare for the upcoming primary and general elections in 2024!**
[](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=8b0220a0b5&e=95417d7e87)
The 2024 General Election is just around the corner but there is much work to be done — and we can’t do it alone! New Pennsylvania Project is on a mission to register 60,000 voters from across the Commonwealth, with a focus on reaching those from underserved and underrepresented communities. We can’t do that, however, without your continued support. If you haven’t yet, please consider clicking the button below and investing just a few dollars in these efforts.
Every dollar helps us host more events, reach more people, and ultimately, register more voters ahead of this incredibly high-stakes election!
[Invest in our Democracy](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6f37377541&e=95417d7e87)
|
---
Thank you for taking the time to stay informed. We'll be back in two weeks with the latest edition. In solidarity,#TeamNPP

Friend, I made a bit of a risky decision:
**Earlier this week, I authorized our new TV ads to launch _a week early_ ,** even though the money wasn’t in our budget. My finance director wasn’t exactly _thrilled_ with the idea at first, but she came around once I explained why. Let me fill you in:
I'm officially the most vulnerable woman in the Senate, and dark money groups like the Koch network are pouring _millions_ into Nevada to flip my seat red.

Right now, it’s critical we keep our ads on air – because having these ads up and running is the best way to counter the GOP's attacks.
**But now, we’re facing a $500,000 budget gap that we have to make up to keep****these new ads on the air.** We absolutely can’t afford to fall further behind right now, but I told my finance director that I trust top supporters like you to have my back.

name: The Office of Delegate Briana D. Sewell
subject: Del. Sewell's April 4th Newsletter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Briana Sewell
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/New%20Sewell%20Delegate%20Logo%20.png]
April 4th Newsletter
Dear neighbors,
I want to thank each of you for your engagement with my office during this legislative session, whether you wrote to me regarding your perspective on legislation, visited my office to discuss items of importance to you, attended one of my community events, invited me to or just subscribed to my newsletter to get frequent updates on the work taking place in the General Assembly. THANK YOU!
This week, I’m sharing headlines from the General Assembly, resources from organizations in the community, what I’ve been doing around the district, and events you may want to attend in Prince William County.
General Assembly News
Below are some headlines about the General Assembly that I thought you might find interesting.
Youngkin signs bill filed after shooting death of Henrico teen [https://virginiamercury.com/2024/03/27/youngkin-signs-bill-filed-after-shooting-death-of-henrico-teen-vetoes-30-others-related-to-guns/] | Virginia Mercury
Republican Gov. Glenn Youngkin handed down several vetoes, amendments and signatures on a number of gun and public safety bills the Democratic-controlled legislature pushed for this session.
Youngkin vetoes 30 gun bills, signs 4, amends 6 [https://cardinalnews.org/2024/03/26/youngkin-vetoes-30-gun-bills-signs-4-amends-6/] | Cardinal News
The governor’s veto count now totals 121 — the same number that Democrat Terry McAuliffe signed during his entire four-year term.
Youngkin signs homemade food bill inspired by ‘kingpin of cake pops [https://virginiamercury.com/2024/03/25/youngkin-signs-homemade-food-bill-inspired-by-kingpin-of-cake-pops/] ’ | Virginia Mercury
New law eases limits on small sellers of pickles and baked goods. The front yard of Virginia’s Executive Mansion was turned into a miniature farmers market Monday as Gov. Glenn Youngkin signed a bill meant to make life a little easier for a home baker he called “the kingpin of cake pops.”
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/IMG_3390.jpg] Virginia Families First Tour - I proudly stood alongside Senate Appropriations and Finance Chair Lucas, House Appropriations Chair Torian, and Senate Majority Caucus Chair Locke, to support the record breaking investments in public education included in the conference budget which passed both chambers of the Virginia General Assembly with bipartisan support.
Community Events
April 5th from 6-9pm | Kid’s Night Out: Once a month, Veterans Memorial Park staff host a Kid’s Night Out where you can drop off your kids ages 5-12 for an evening of fun games, art, and more! Limited to the first 20 kids (Veterans Memorial Park, 14300 Veterans Dr, Woodbridge). Register here [https://parksandrec.pwcgov.org/wbwsc/webtrac.wsc/search.html?Action=Start&SubAction=&location=1VET&keyword=kid%27s&display=Listing&sort=BeginDate] .
April 5th from 9am-3pm | Scam Jam: The Area Agency on Aging and AARP are partnering to offer their 3rd Annual Scam Jam. Learn how to avoid becoming a victim of scams, get tips from the FBI, learn how artificial intelligence is enabling scammers, and bring sensitive documents for secure paper shredding. Registration is required. Call 1-877-926-8300 or visit events.aarp.org/WoodbridgeSJ24 [http://events.aarp.org/WoodbridgeSJ24] to register.
April 10th from 7-9pm | PWC Planning Commission Meeting: Hear from the planning commission about projects before their body and learn more about how decisions on land use and zoning are made in Prince William County.
April 13th from 9am-1pm | Spring 2024 Occoquan District Area Dumpster Day Event: Clean up your neighborhood and take out your bulk trash! Join this community dumpster day event and help keep our neighborhoods beautiful! The event will take place at 12619 Oakwood Drive, Woodbridge, VA 22192.
April 16th from 7-8:30pm | Virtual Class on Predatory Lending : Virginia Cooperative Extension and The Financial Empowerment Center (FEC) at Prince William County is hosting a virtual class that will help you understand predatory lending (car title loans, payday loans and pawn shop loans). You will learn about predatory lending and what makes it so bad. You will also learn what to do if you have become a victim of predatory lending. To register please click here [https://bit.ly/PredatoryLendingRegistration] .
State and Community Resources and News
Veterans Services Resources: The Department of Veterans Services has many resources to take advantage of if you are a veteran. Check out the list below to see if there is anything useful to you. If you have questions that aren’t answered by the resources below, I encourage you to go to the VA DVS website by clicking here: https://www.dvs.virginia.gov/ [https://www.dvs.virginia.gov/]
Click here [https://vesa.dvs.virginia.gov/?ct=t(Y_COPY_01)] to make a virtual or face-to-face appointment with a DVS representative.
Click here [https://virginia.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfb1694b4da19845ebd86f6ab&id=d41fb01f1b&e=8649db6519] to download the DVS Virginia Veterans Resource Guide.
Click here [https://virginia.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfb1694b4da19845ebd86f6ab&id=21a2f12388&e=8649db6519] to read the Re-entry Roadmap for Veterans Incarcerated in Virginia.
Click here [https://virginia.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfb1694b4da19845ebd86f6ab&id=a4ac8a7bdd&e=8649db6519] to download the DVS Agency brochure.
Click here [https://virginia.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfb1694b4da19845ebd86f6ab&id=7e1a435895&e=8649db6519] to evaluate your military experience for college credits and see how they apply to Virginia Community College System programs that support your career goals.
Click here [http://here] to learn how to obtain a veteran indicator on your Virginia license.
Click here [https://virginia.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfb1694b4da19845ebd86f6ab&id=0274bf76d8&e=8649db6519] to learn about the Veteran Employment Grant for V3 companies.
Click here [https://virginia.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfb1694b4da19845ebd86f6ab&id=a7ea0baf83&e=8649db6519] to download a Virginia Resident Disabled Veterans’ Lifetime Hunting and Fishing License Application (Department of Wildlife Resources).
Click here [https://virginia.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfb1694b4da19845ebd86f6ab&id=1dd4bb6b10&e=8649db6519] for a free service that can help you find the local resources you need. 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
Neighborhood Services in PWC: Many community members reach out to our office with questions about their HOA, how to get involved, and what services they may provide. Your HOA is a great resource for all of these questions, but there is also a division of county government who liaises with HOAs and can let you know what services or resources may be available to you around your neighborhood association. Learn more about neighborhood services here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/neighborhood-services] , and check out their list of resources here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/neighborhood-services/resources] .
ACTS (Action in Community Through Service) PWC: ACTS provides food assistance to community members who may be struggling with hunger or food insecurity. You can receive food for your household from ACTS up to once a month and they accept all clients on a walk-in basis with no appointment required at their offices 3901 ACTS Lane, Dumfries. See information about their hours and services here [https://www.actspwc.org/services/food-assistance] .
ARC of NoVA Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month: I am proud to share this campaign from the ARC of NoVA which highlights how people with and without disabilities come together to form strong communities. Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month raises awareness of the inclusion and contributions of people with developmental disabilities in all aspects of community life, and it's a time to explore the work we still need to do to remove barriers. Share your story of inclusion on the ARC of NoVA’s website here [https://thearcofnova.org/share-your-story/] .
Fast2Feed Ramadan Campaign: Humanity First USA (HFUSA) is launching its annual Fast2Feed campaign during the month of Ramadan this year from March 12th, 2024 through April 10th, 2024. If you have means, consider contributing to this worthy cause here [https://fundraise.humanityfirst.org/campaign/fast-2-feed/c276699] .
Solarize NoVA: This year marks the 10th anniversary of Solarize NoVA, a campaign dedicated to accelerating Virginia's transition to solar energy. From April 1st to June 30th, they are partnering with the Northern Virginia Regional Commission, the Local Energy Alliance Program and local solar installers to embark on a mission to make solar energy more accessible and affordable. To sign up for free or learn more information, go to www.solarizenova.org. [http://www.solarizenova.org]
Dominion Spring Storm Season Warnings: Are you ready for potential power outages caused by storms this spring? As we start the spring weather season, Dominion Energy encourages everyone to use this opportunity to make sure they are prepared for the next weather incident, whenever it may come. First, stay away from downed power lines. If you see a power line low to or on the ground, please report it by calling 866-DOM-HELP and stay at least 30 feet away. The line could be energized and dangerous. Second, know how to report an outage and track restoration. There are three easy ways:
1) Dominion Energy mobile apps, Google and iPhone;
2) Dominion Energy website; or
3) Call 866-DOM-HELP (866-366-4357). If you haven't already, download the app before the storm comes.
For more storm information and hurricane preparedness tips, please visit www.dominionenergy.com/our-stories/hurricane-preparedness [http://www.dominionenergy.com/our-stories/hurricane-preparedness] .
Funding Opportunities, Awards, and Grants
Sentara Cares Grants: If you or an organization you work with is working to address prominent social drivers of health, including equitable access to behavioral health and skilled careers, there may be a grant in store for you! Sentara provides competitive grants for eligible organizations working to improve the health and well-being of individuals and communities through programs that align with Sentara’s funding priorities. Grant applications will be open until April 11. Visit this webpage [https://sentaracares.com/apply-for-a-grant/?utm_source=sfmc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240315_CommunityLeaderNewsletter_March&utm_id=526927&utm_sfmc=549771069#funding-priorities] to learn more. Ready to start your application? Click here [https://sentara.tfaforms.net/f/grantapplication] .
Virginia Aviation Business Association Charles J. Colgan Scholarship : Do you know a student pursuing Aviation or Aerospace studies? The Virginia Aviation Business Association's prestigious Charles J. Colgan Scholarship awaits! High school, technical school seniors, and college/university undergraduates pursuing an aviation- or aerospace-related career at an accredited institution in Virginia are eligible to apply. Award Amount $2,000, Application Deadline: Friday, April 26th, 2024 . Click here [https://www.thevaba.org/colgan-application] for details about the application process & requirements.
National Health Service Corps Scholarship Program: Scholarships for students pursuing eligible primary care health professions training in exchange for a service commitment in an approved site in a Health Professional Shortage Area. Application Deadline: April 25, 2024. Learn more here: https://nhsc.hrsa.gov/scholarships/how-to-apply [https://nhsc.hrsa.gov/scholarships/how-to-apply]
Community Level Innovations for Improving Health Outcome: Grants for projects that demonstrate community level innovations to increase use of preventive health services, improve health outcomes, and reduce health disparities driven by social determinants of health. Application Deadline: May 15, 2024. Learn more here: https://www.grants.gov/search-results-detail/349434 [https://www.grants.gov/search-results-detail/349434]
Brown Teacher Research Fellowship: The Anne & Ryland Brown Teacher Research Fellowship program enhances knowledge and training in history and social science instruction in Virginia by providing educators the opportunity for in-depth study and the development of teaching materials. The Library of Virginia’s 2024 Brown Fellowships will focus on research and projects that explore Virginia’s Indigenous history in support of the Library’s current exhibition, Indigenous Perspectives, which highlights the commonwealth’s Indigenous history and how the tribes remain a vital part of Virginia today. The Library seeks one educator each from the Virginia Department of Education superintendent regions 1, 4, 6, and 8. Fellows receive a stipend of $3,000. Applications Due May 10. Learn more here [https://edu.lva.virginia.gov/brown/brown-fellowship/brown-teacher-research-fellowship-information/?blm_aid=1779717428] .
Dominion Energy Solar Program for Low Income and Elderly Homeowners : Do you own a home and make less than $65,000 a year? You may qualify for Dominion energy to install solar on your house for free. Learn more about this program on Dominion’s website here [https://www.dominionenergy.com/virginia/save-energy/income-and-age-qualifying-solar-program] and check out this article on WAVY-TV here [https://www.wavy.com/news/local-news/dominion-energys-solar-program-saves-families-thousands-of-dollars/] to learn more about how Dominion’s Energy’s Income and Age Qualifying Program has helped families.
Stay in touch with my office by sending me an email about what events you are organizing in the community and inviting me to speak. You can email my team at DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov [http://DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov] or call us at 703-261-4787. We look forward to hearing from you, and please stay tuned as we continue to provide important updates about what’s going on in Prince William County, and what is on tap for our office between now and the reconvene session.
In service,
Briana Sewell

clean_body: [] April 4th Newsletter Dear neighbors, I want to thank each of you for your engagement with my office during this legislative session, whether you wrote to me regarding your perspective on legislation, visited my office to discuss items of importance to you, attended one of my community events, invited me to or just subscribed to my newsletter to get frequent updates on the work taking place in the General Assembly. THANK YOU! This week, I’m sharing headlines from the General Assembly, resources from organizations in the community, what I’ve been doing around the district, and events you may want to attend in Prince William County. General Assembly News Below are some headlines about the General Assembly that I thought you might find interesting. Youngkin signs bill filed after shooting death of Henrico teen [] | Virginia Mercury Republican Gov. Glenn Youngkin handed down several vetoes, amendments and signatures on a number of gun and public safety bills the Democratic-controlled legislature pushed for this session. Youngkin vetoes 30 gun bills, signs 4, amends 6 [] | Cardinal News The governor’s veto count now totals 121 — the same number that Democrat Terry McAuliffe signed during his entire four-year term. Youngkin signs homemade food bill inspired by ‘kingpin of cake pops [] ’ | Virginia Mercury New law eases limits on small sellers of pickles and baked goods. The front yard of Virginia’s Executive Mansion was turned into a miniature farmers market Monday as Gov. Glenn Youngkin signed a bill meant to make life a little easier for a home baker he called “the kingpin of cake pops.” [] Virginia Families First Tour - I proudly stood alongside Senate Appropriations and Finance Chair Lucas, House Appropriations Chair Torian, and Senate Majority Caucus Chair Locke, to support the record breaking investments in public education included in the conference budget which passed both chambers of the Virginia General Assembly with bipartisan support. Community Events April 5th from 6-9pm | Kid’s Night Out: Once a month, Veterans Memorial Park staff host a Kid’s Night Out where you can drop off your kids ages 5-12 for an evening of fun games, art, and more! Limited to the first 20 kids (Veterans Memorial Park, 14300 Veterans Dr, Woodbridge). Register here [] . April 5th from 9am-3pm | Scam Jam: The Area Agency on Aging and AARP are partnering to offer their 3rd Annual Scam Jam. Learn how to avoid becoming a victim of scams, get tips from the FBI, learn how artificial intelligence is enabling scammers, and bring sensitive documents for secure paper shredding. Registration is required. Call 1-877-926-8300 or visit events.aarp.org/WoodbridgeSJ24 [] to register. April 10th from 7-9pm | PWC Planning Commission Meeting: Hear from the planning commission about projects before their body and learn more about how decisions on land use and zoning are made in Prince William County. April 13th from 9am-1pm | Spring 2024 Occoquan District Area Dumpster Day Event: Clean up your neighborhood and take out your bulk trash! Join this community dumpster day event and help keep our neighborhoods beautiful! The event will take place at 12619 Oakwood Drive, Woodbridge, VA 22192. April 16th from 7-8:30pm | Virtual Class on Predatory Lending : Virginia Cooperative Extension and The Financial Empowerment Center (FEC) at Prince William County is hosting a virtual class that will help you understand predatory lending (car title loans, payday loans and pawn shop loans). You will learn about predatory lending and what makes it so bad. You will also learn what to do if you have become a victim of predatory lending. To register please click here [] . State and Community Resources and News Veterans Services Resources: The Department of Veterans Services has many resources to take advantage of if you are a veteran. Check out the list below to see if there is anything useful to you. If you have questions that aren’t answered by the resources below, I encourage you to go to the VA DVS website by clicking here: [] Click here [)] to make a virtual or face-to-face appointment with a DVS representative. Click here [] to download the DVS Virginia Veterans Resource Guide. Click here [] to read the Re-entry Roadmap for Veterans Incarcerated in Virginia. Click here [] to download the DVS Agency brochure. Click here [] to evaluate your military experience for college credits and see how they apply to Virginia Community College System programs that support your career goals. Click here [] to learn how to obtain a veteran indicator on your Virginia license. Click here [] to learn about the Veteran Employment Grant for V3 companies. Click here [] to download a Virginia Resident Disabled Veterans’ Lifetime Hunting and Fishing License Application (Department of Wildlife Resources). Click here [] for a free service that can help you find the local resources you need. 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Neighborhood Services in PWC: Many community members reach out to our office with questions about their HOA, how to get involved, and what services they may provide. Your HOA is a great resource for all of these questions, but there is also a division of county government who liaises with HOAs and can let you know what services or resources may be available to you around your neighborhood association. Learn more about neighborhood services here [] , and check out their list of resources here [] . ACTS (Action in Community Through Service) PWC: ACTS provides food assistance to community members who may be struggling with hunger or food insecurity. You can receive food for your household from ACTS up to once a month and they accept all clients on a walk-in basis with no appointment required at their offices 3901 ACTS Lane, Dumfries. See information about their hours and services here [] . ARC of NoVA Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month: I am proud to share this campaign from the ARC of NoVA which highlights how people with and without disabilities come together to form strong communities. Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month raises awareness of the inclusion and contributions of people with developmental disabilities in all aspects of community life, and it's a time to explore the work we still need to do to remove barriers. Share your story of inclusion on the ARC of NoVA’s website here [] . Fast2Feed Ramadan Campaign: Humanity First USA (HFUSA) is launching its annual Fast2Feed campaign during the month of Ramadan this year from March 12th, 2024 through April 10th, 2024. If you have means, consider contributing to this worthy cause here [] . Solarize NoVA: This year marks the 10th anniversary of Solarize NoVA, a campaign dedicated to accelerating Virginia's transition to solar energy. From April 1st to June 30th, they are partnering with the Northern Virginia Regional Commission, the Local Energy Alliance Program and local solar installers to embark on a mission to make solar energy more accessible and affordable. To sign up for free or learn more information, go to www.solarizenova.org. [] Dominion Spring Storm Season Warnings: Are you ready for potential power outages caused by storms this spring? As we start the spring weather season, Dominion Energy encourages everyone to use this opportunity to make sure they are prepared for the next weather incident, whenever it may come. First, stay away from downed power lines. If you see a power line low to or on the ground, please report it by calling 866-DOM-HELP and stay at least 30 feet away. The line could be energized and dangerous. Second, know how to report an outage and track restoration. There are three easy ways: 1) Dominion Energy mobile apps, Google and iPhone; 2) Dominion Energy website; or 3) Call 866-DOM-HELP (866-366-4357). If you haven't already, download the app before the storm comes. For more storm information and hurricane preparedness tips, please visit www.dominionenergy.com/our-stories/hurricane-preparedness [] . Funding Opportunities, Awards, and Grants Sentara Cares Grants: If you or an organization you work with is working to address prominent social drivers of health, including equitable access to behavioral health and skilled careers, there may be a grant in store for you! Sentara provides competitive grants for eligible organizations working to improve the health and well-being of individuals and communities through programs that align with Sentara’s funding priorities. Grant applications will be open until April 11. Visit this webpage [] to learn more. Ready to start your application? Click here [] . Virginia Aviation Business Association Charles J. Colgan Scholarship : Do you know a student pursuing Aviation or Aerospace studies? The Virginia Aviation Business Association's prestigious Charles J. Colgan Scholarship awaits! High school, technical school seniors, and college/university undergraduates pursuing an aviation- or aerospace-related career at an accredited institution in Virginia are eligible to apply. Award Amount $2,000, Application Deadline: Friday, April 26th, 2024 . Click here [] for details about the application process & requirements. National Health Service Corps Scholarship Program: Scholarships for students pursuing eligible primary care health professions training in exchange for a service commitment in an approved site in a Health Professional Shortage Area. Application Deadline: April 25, 2024. Learn more here: [] Community Level Innovations for Improving Health Outcome: Grants for projects that demonstrate community level innovations to increase use of preventive health services, improve health outcomes, and reduce health disparities driven by social determinants of health. Application Deadline: May 15, 2024. Learn more here: [] Brown Teacher Research Fellowship: The Anne & Ryland Brown Teacher Research Fellowship program enhances knowledge and training in history and social science instruction in Virginia by providing educators the opportunity for in-depth study and the development of teaching materials. The Library of Virginia’s 2024 Brown Fellowships will focus on research and projects that explore Virginia’s Indigenous history in support of the Library’s current exhibition, Indigenous Perspectives, which highlights the commonwealth’s Indigenous history and how the tribes remain a vital part of Virginia today. The Library seeks one educator each from the Virginia Department of Education superintendent regions 1, 4, 6, and 8. Fellows receive a stipend of $3,000. Applications Due May 10. Learn more here [] . Dominion Energy Solar Program for Low Income and Elderly Homeowners : Do you own a home and make less than $65,000 a year? You may qualify for Dominion energy to install solar on your house for free. Learn more about this program on Dominion’s website here [] and check out this article on WAVY-TV here [] to learn more about how Dominion’s Energy’s Income and Age Qualifying Program has helped families. Stay in touch with my office by sending me an email about what events you are organizing in the community and inviting me to speak. You can email my team at DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov [] or call us at 703-261-4787. We look forward to hearing from you, and please stay tuned as we continue to provide important updates about what’s going on in Prince William County, and what is on tap for our office between now and the reconvene session. In service, Briana Sewell Paid for by Friends of Briana Sewell. I used assault weapons in the Army. I was in combat. I have rushed towards gunfire. So I say these things with full confidence: **Assault weapons belong in battle, not our neighborhoods.** **Kevlar belongs in combat gear, not kids' backpacks.** **Guns should be in the hands of vetted, responsible owners – not just anyone with some cash.** **Our streets, schools, movie theaters, houses of worship, and homes should not be battlefields.** So imagine my outrage when Brian Fitzpatrick single-handedly BLOCKED commonsense gun legislation last summer that would have banned assault weapons (like the one involved in last month's Levittown mass shooting) and required universal background checks. We do NOT have to live in a country where the #1 cause of death for kids is gun violence. Where it is easier to get a gun than an abortion. But we won't change that with Brian Fitzpatrick in Congress. _**[That's why I'm asking for your support. Fitzpatrick has a huge war chest and takes corporate PAC money.
