| | **This woman literally changed the course of history.** With _Roe_ on the books for more than 50 years, Mississippi Attorney General Lynn Fitch had the audacity to challenge the status quo. She took her state’s pro-life law to the Supreme Court and asked them to overturn an unconstitutional decision and return power to the states to protect life. And, now, she’s coming to speak at our Conference. **[REGISTER TODAY TO HEAR LYNN FITCH AND OUR EPIC LINEUP OF SPEAKERS! ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/20fa721eee516d8a3947229f28c3afba/f1bcba6b0896421fc3d6b838967d376c/44483)**** In addition to her work on the Dobbs case, Lynn Fitch is pacing the country in ensuring her state does more than ever to care for pregnant women and establish a culture of life. She is not simply “anti-abortion.” She’s leading with compassion and showing how to truly be “pro-life” and to value both the woman and the child. I cannot wait to hear what she has to say! _And, in addition to this exciting announcement, we are excited to share more about how our Conference is coming into focus. Here is a simple overview of **SOME** of the speaking spots we have filled. We will announce more on Friday and over the next week or two as we provide a complete picture of what to expect at this incredible event:_

Friend, I have breaking news to share with you... We at America First Legal have just filed an **absolutely momentous** lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona's election administration laws. The election interference and systematic election law violations we allege in Arizona are appalling, bone-chilling, and have the most serious consequences for every American. name: Jacob Thifault
subject: Door Knock with Max this Saturday! (And beyond!)
body:
Thank you for your willingness to support/volunteer for Max Engling as he works to win on May 7th – now in the homestretch we need your help getting the message out to voters!

Join us this Saturday as we canvas in Tipton and Russiaville. It’s a great time together and an opportunity to help get Max across the finish line. Head over, get a shirt, and spread the message!

Before you Knock

1. RSVP with your first, last name, and shirt size (reply all to this email) – anyone is welcome – bring a friend!

2. Download the Numinar App from the App Store.

MORNING Door Knocking (Tipton)

Date: Saturday, April 6, 2024

Meet-up Location: Rock Prairie Church parking lot (421 Ash St. Tipton, IN)

Time: 9:30AM - Donuts and Door Knocking

o Meet up in the church parking lot

o Receive instructions, handouts, walk-list, and script

o Head out to doors – you’re free to knock through one or multiple walk-lists (one list usually takes about 1.5-2 hours)

AFTERNOON Door Knocking (Russiaville)

Date: Saturday, April 6, 2024

Meet-up Location: Russiaville Public Library parking lot (315 Mesa Dr. Russiaville, IN)

Time: 2:00PM - Door Knocking then Fish & Tenderloin Fry!

* Meet up in the library parking lot
* Receive instructions, handouts, walk-list, and script
* Head out to doors – you’re free to knock through one or multiple walk-lists (one list usually takes about 1.5-2 hours)
* When we're done knocking, we will gather for dinner, Max's treat!

EVENING Lions Club Fish & Tenderloin Fry! (Russiaville)

Date: Saturday, April 6, 2024

Dinner Location: Russiaville Lions Club (555 N. Liberty St. Russiaville, IN)

Time: 5:00PM - Dinner (Max's treat for anyone that knocks doors!)

Don't feel nervous! We are only knocking the easiest doors - Republicans that vote in every election. It is always a great time!

Reply-all that you are able to come out and we'll see you on Saturday!

UPCOMING OPPORTUNITIES:

* Saturday, April 13 @9:30am – door knocking in Anderson
* Saturday, April 13 @1:30pm - door knocking in Daleville
* Saturday, April 20 @9:30am - door knocking in Noblesville
* Saturday, April 20 @1:30pm - door knocking in Cicero
* (Details to come on all events)

Sincerely,

Jacob Thifault

Political Director

(317) 420-1440

name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: Join Us for a Virtual HealingUS Candlelight Vigil for Danny Desnoyers with Briahna Joy Gray
body:
Join us for a compelling screening of the film by Kenny Ballentine and Maddy Purves, narrated by Susan Sarandon, underscoring the critical need for a compassionate healthcare system.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healingus&n=1)
---
## HealingUS Candlelight Vigil for Danny Desnoyers & Medicare For All
**[Virtual (Zoom) - Register Here](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=Vzj4AQ8kSqaLc-7qMI-_pFgsqaHLzayB65Uc6AkFNz1gVJAPxRDTP0v44PIQc5p73_y9oUUw4R0DwKZVI-xDLv-S4U6E6kwBKFBvU2-9LJI&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healingus&n=2)
****Date: Tuesday, April 9th** **Time: 5pm PT /****8pm ET****** **Show your Solidarity -[pick up a Red Beret from Associate Producer Laura Fielding!](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healingus&n=3)**
**** This event is a call to action. Together, we can illuminate the path to health justice and honor Danny's memory by fighting for a future where no life is lost due to the inaccessibility of medical care. **** **Please also bring a lit candle to the vigil,** allowing us to create a powerful visual moment of remembrance and unity across our virtual gathering. Share using the hashtag #HealingUSWithLove
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_vigil?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healingus&n=4)
---
Join us in an evening of action as we remember Danny Desnoyers and the 68,000 precious human lives lost every year due to lack of adequate healthcare. This event aims not only to honor Danny's memory but also to ignite a movement demanding transformative change in our healthcare system. We'll unite our voices in a call for **national improved, single-payer Medicare for All** , challenging the greed of health insurance corporations.
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=Vzj4AQ8kSqaLc-7qMI-_pFgsqaHLzayB65Uc6AkFNz1gVJAPxRDTP0v44PIQc5p73_y9oUUw4R0DwKZVI-xDLrw_yjpUnrH5mhRtt8uDQjRsYTCasCNjPR_hGB9u2seZ&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healingus&n=5 "Register to Attend this Event") [Register to Attend this Event](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=Vzj4AQ8kSqaLc-7qMI-_pFgsqaHLzayB65Uc6AkFNz1gVJAPxRDTP0v44PIQc5p73_y9oUUw4R0DwKZVI-xDLrw_yjpUnrH5mhRtt8uDQjRsYTCasCNjPR_hGB9u2seZ&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healingus&n=5)
---
**Event Highlights:**
* **Screening:** "HealingUS," a film by Kenny Ballentine and Maddy Purves, narrated by Susan Sarandon on the need for a compassionate healthcare system.
* **Panel Discussion:** Featuring distinguished guests **Briahna Joy Gray, Dr. Victoria Dooley** and others discussing the push for Medicare for All via executive order under Section 1881A of the Social Security Act.
* **Petition Launch:** A collective action to challenge the current administration's opposition and to advocate for health justice in memory of Danny.

In solidarity, **Team Cornel West 2024** _**P.S. Do not underestimate the power of your voice—help spread the word that we have an option for TRUTH, JUSTICE and LOVE in 2024 so future generations can have brighter options that put people before profit.**_
---

---
Did you see this headline, Derek? _The Washington Post:_
[](https://click.act.democrats.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvpOShxPWr9mFhJMw1S-wTtsWJ4oHmyX6l1dZXrMu59XkqaLmdnimuDefwh5_O-3pTImcFpPvSU2kHvu9H1tY9E90lBXsjd1QrtciYEotNBU6EExQfaBdWzdRp__EGyu3m1GDflfU0Uimq0BfcQRpTY26h-grt84m4F77wNzEElKQc6-QCMfBJ946NxjEwZe4MVOg-neZmp9VZ3gSJAE6mg9075_fdTNHbGp-fVCSWy6jVtpB9CBAsbaUju6UCGYybh2L3u2RLMWIwajx2tXBHJt_0ZmoSvsPS1pPKB6WfQFwwYVqa2IqrIuozyGQAHn8HMpdv9N9nrUPOizVHCh9bYMFFuZVny99U7_bOpeUX2obfgR9NXSOnUaRhZJ4v-cskfL3vwdfBceGE7RjE1M66O/458/aE5ga3iVSCeEiKvsIblB7A/h0/h001.vHeZoGMZ82QRynLLWJidcN-N6Nmns0IWbTOaCI0og8s)

It’s critical Democrats have the resources to fight back. [ **CHIP IN $7** ](https://click.act.democrats.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvpOShxPWr9mFhJMw1S-wTtsWJ4oHmyX6l1dZXrMu59XkqaLmdnimuDefwh5_O-3pTImcFpPvSU2kHvu9H1tY9E90lBXsjd1QrtciYEotNBU6EExQfaBdWzdRp__EGyu3l-_iblMYD3CQFgFFgWG2YalbBADKZWzwbwCbqnF47UH5fv_dCrz29Onobi5Tli9_LBMLRTRn0BJQrlMtuL9uV4l1vsdY9b908C8zqbL5YD5azeUIqwmlj3v3qmCIN9Wg8J7WwvXNzmt2NtYOm8GOjzbJqB9HCb6ZexMrEm-wkoai-Dg3sWbdJUQivytfh3rGKxa9vZH7Gd_nkSUzdZ0fIfkIYPGcl7iRzbxs9P_LpoWEQVjdW4aRKvnzTBptPC6KCdv9XiXp5Dd4WLevXVyabj/458/aE5ga3iVSCeEiKvsIblB7A/h2/h001.DnysScqwj4G8moMkKhd5V1VdYZKBS8pneqBNmj8sJOU)

body:
So much to tell you about.

| Peter -- We have a lot to talk about this month! This is one of the best times yet to get involved so please read on to see which ways fit your interests best. Then drop us a line to let us know!
## **Thank you to everyone that participated in our 3/26 Candidate Launch Events.**
We're excited to finally introduce everyone to our two 2024 State wide candidates, Eric Settle for Attorney General and Chris Foster for Treasurer. https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89

She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.

As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.

body:

| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6b509879-f482-4635-9644-0c3bd6a7e0c6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
| | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb6b05390-3cec-45bd-a60e-069249dd60b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I wanted you to be the first to hear the big news: I’m launching my campaign for Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District.

[I’d like to tell you my story, and ask you to chip in to my campaign for a better future for Wisconsin and our country.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcd769dab-bd96-49d5-9009-f1ffd621fb40/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I grew up in northeast Wisconsin, in a working class family where too often, we struggled.

As a kid, I would never have dreamed of running for office – though I always wanted to serve my community. I’ve been practicing medicine for years, focusing on women’s health and reproductive care, while working particularly in underserved communities. But today, I’m not practicing in the Green Bay area, where I grew up and where I live. Thanks first to the harsh restrictions on abortion care in Wisconsin that were passed in 1849 – before women could even vote – and then to the threat of retaliation from Republicans after I helped overturn those restrictions I travel to Minnesota every month, and also travel to Arizona to continue to care for patients who need it most. Those long commutes have given me plenty of time to think about where we’re at as a state, and as a country. I’ve spent a lot of time talking with my neighbors, fellow doctors, and folks all across our community about the challenges we’re facing. Our healthcare system is in crisis. Doctors and nurses are leaving the field in droves. There’s confusion about how we can care for our patients under new restrictions that are a direct result of Dobbs. And it all goes back to the division that too many politicians have sown in recent years. I’m running for office to do something about it. We have a real opportunity to flip this open seat, put an end to the divisiveness, and pass policies that help families in northeast Wisconsin – and every corner of the country. From expanding rural broadband access to implementing a social safety net that catches struggling families, we’ve got a lot of work to do. It won’t be easy. But most things worth doing aren’t easy. [I’m running for Congress to make a difference, and I’m asking for your support. If you’re with me, I hope you’ll chip in $5 or more to my campaign.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T18e711ae-3693-4ce9-a392-93624398ee56/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Kristin Dr. Kristin Lyerly

Three reasons why your support goes furthest in Missouri.
#
Peter,
Did you know that Missouri is our most cost-effective opportunity to flip a GOP-held U.S. Senate seat this November? Here’s why:
1. **Josh Hawley is seriously vulnerable.** In 2018, Hawley won his Senate seat with only 51% of the vote. After he exposed himself to be a fraud and a coward on January 6, _Morning Consult_ confirmed that he’s the least popular GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election this year — with even lower approval ratings than Ted Cruz and Rick Scott.
2. **We’re building the grassroots movement that can defeat Josh Hawley.** After outraising Hawley in 2023 and earning major endorsements from groups like the Missouri AFL-CIO, End Citizens United, and League of Conservation Voters, Lucas Kunce has proved that he’s building a winning campaign and coalition for this Senate seat. Multiple polls have proved it too — finding this race between Lucas and Hawley in a _statistical tie._
3. **Every $1 here in Missouri can go nearly five times as far compared to states like Texas and Florida.** Missouri’s media markets are small, meaning that we’ll be able to reach Missourians with Lucas’ message early and often for a fraction of what it would cost in those other big states.

Our record-breaking, people-powered movement can defeat Josh Hawley and elect a real warrior for working people like Lucas Kunce to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. But the only way we’ll be able to get our election-winning message in front of voters is with support from real people like you. **So we’re asking:**

**Service is at the core of who I am.** I refuse to stand by and watch the radical Left destroy the country I fought to defend. That's why I ran for Congress in 2022.

**After a hard-fought race, my Team and I won by LESS THAN 0.5%!** I'm serving my country again, but this time here at home. Fighting for our freedoms in DC has been such an honor. But because we embarrassed the Democrats, they want me _GONE_.

---
Hi Peter, I wanted you to hear the news from me: [**_I’m officially running for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 7th District._**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/tJBpVbhEFM7jhn2U4odpkQ~~/AAPPAAA~~) When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together. “What has changed” they ask? Everything. Together, our A-Team has...
* Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.
* Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
* Advocated for justice for the people, from peacefully protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza.

**This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted inhumanity and love — but only if we keep fighting.** [**_So Peter, I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $27 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Maxwell Frost. We rely on small-dollar donations to do this work, and your support will ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. Thank you._**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/tJBpVbhEFM7jhn2U4odpkQ~~/AAPPAAA~~) | [DONATE $27 >>](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/tJBpVbhEFM7jhn2U4odpkQ~~/AAPPAAA~~)
---
Six years ago, this team elected the first Black woman and first person of color to represent Massachusetts in Congress — but this movement is about so much more than that.
I told this team that if you sent me to Washington, I wasn’t going alone. I was bringing all of you with me. You all are my teachers, my partners, and my accomplices. The issues that you care about are the issues I fight for.
By investing in our campaign, you are affirming the dignity and worth of every person who has been left out and left behind.
You are sending a message that corporate interests should never win over working people.
You’re affirming that abortion is health care.
That a college education should move us forward, not set us back.
That Black men deserve to grow old.
That you believe that all of our children deserve a future — whether they’re in Massachusetts, Gaza, or Haiti.
That this movement is STRONG.
I love the Massachusetts 7th district.
[**_It is an honor to represent the people of the Massachusetts 7th, and this movement, in Congress. If you can, please split a donation of $27 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Maxwell Frost during this important moment._**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/tJBpVbhEFM7jhn2U4odpkQ~~/AAPPAAA~~)

---
Dear Peter,
Rarely do opposites attract, especially in Washington.
Yet regarding the case of Julian Assange, the WikiLeaks founder who is facing extradition to the US, both hard-right Marjorie Taylor Green and hard-left Ilhan Omar Agree:
[We Must Free Assange Now!](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_p2_4_4_24_rs_nd1&n=3)
It is urgent you and I take action right now by [clicking here](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_p2_4_4_24_rs_nd1&n=4). Congress and the President can stop this outrageous miscarriage of justice by supporting the passage of House Resolution 934 – Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives:
| _“Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that regular journalistic activities are protected under the First Amendment, and that the United States ought to drop all charges against and attempts to extradite Julian Assange.”_
---
Time is short. We are calling on you to help our campaign help political prisoner Julian Assange regain his freedom once and for all.
You see, over the last 72 hours, a British Court put off extraditing Assange to the US Military Authorities on one condition: the US government must assure the Brits that Assange will not face the death penalty for his alleged crimes.
[We Must Free Assange Now!](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_p2_4_4_24_rs_nd1&n=5)
The Brits want to make sure our government doesn’t kill Assange. This is the reality that every American Citizen faces – from Ed Snowden, to Julian Assange to the J6 activists sitting in a Washington DC jail cell stripped of their Constitutional liberties.
[Please help our campaign call out the illiberal actions of our very own government.](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_p2_4_4_24_rs_nd1&n=6) The US Department of Defense is attempting to cover up their war crimes, and for those like Assange who expose the DoD – they are lucky if they escape the death penalty.
Think about that a moment: Freedom of the Press = The Death Penalty. _In what universe are we living?_
If the US Military successfully covers-up their war crimes by locking up Assange – or worse – they will put a massive chilling effect on the First Amendment Freedom of the Press guarantee in the Constitution.
RFK Jr. will continue his fight for justice, for Free Speech, for openness, and he will not stop fighting in the face of government lies.
[If you agree, take action. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_p2_4_4_24_rs_nd1&n=7)
[We Must Free Assange Now!](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_p2_4_4_24_rs_nd1&n=8)

name: Team GIFFORDS
subject: [GOOD NEWS] Colorado’s big step towards public safety →
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
The Colorado Senate passed a bill that would protect polling locations from armed intimidation and prohibit guns in sensitive areas like schools and government buildings.
#

Hey there, we’ve got some good news to share from yesterday out of Colorado:
The Colorado Senate passed a bill that would protect polling locations from armed intimidation and prohibit guns in sensitive areas like schools and government buildings. This legislation was passed in response to the US Supreme Court’s decision in _New York State Rifle & Pistol Association, Inc. v. Bruen_, which weakened the standards that states like Colorado use to decide who can carry guns in public.
Unfortunately, Colorado is no stranger to the impacts of gun violence. Over the years, we’ve seen mass shootings tear apart communities in Boulder, Colorado Springs, Aurora, and Littleton. In the GIFFORDS Law Center scorecard released earlier this year, prohibiting guns from polling places and other sensitive areas was identified as a key way to better protect Coloradans from gun violence. We’re proud the Colorado Senate agreed that these recommendations would have a meaningful impact on public safety.
We know that sometimes this work to end gun violence can feel like a steep uphill climb. But today, we hope you join us in celebrating this win. Don’t forget: your support is what makes progress like this at the state level possible!
All our best,
Team GIFFORDS
* * *

**👋 One more thing before you go:**

If everyone reading this donated just $20, we'd have the resources to take on the gun lobby in Congress and states across the country. But not everyone gives -- that makes it even more important for people who care and understand the stakes of our struggle to chip in what they can.

If $20 seems worth it to you to change our gun laws in order to make our communities safer from gun violence, we're asking you to [**contribute to GIFFORDS today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr24.Y_Rik7&refcode=em240404-1-30&t=1&akid=7898%2E3935704%2EQWf5e3)

| | I have a budget update for you from Washington D.C. And it starts with a word that often gets a bad reputation. _Earmarks._ I have heard it before: our government is simply spending too much. **I agree that we need to be considerate of our budget. But that is why many smart earmarks make sense, because they are an investment by Congress in communities across America in a way that will save money and lives long-term.** Take the recent budget work done in Congress.**I was proud to secure nearly $20 million of the budget for more than a dozen critical infrastructure projects in Northwest Washington.** They are badly needed and include:
* Road safety improvements.
* A bridge replacement.
* Safety improvements in areas vulnerable to flooding.
* A water reservoir project.
* Upgrades at local Sheriff stations.

These are just a few examples. The list goes on, and will benefit so many people across Northwest Washington. **Earmarks like these allow for long-needed local projects to get off the ground, or they allow them to be completed. clean_body: This is the job you sent me to get done | | | | I have a budget update for you from Washington D.C. And it starts with a word that often gets a bad reputation. Earmarks. I have heard it before: our government is simply spending too much. I agree that we need to be considerate of our budget. But that is why many smart earmarks make sense, because they are an investment by Congress in communities across America in a way that will save money and lives long-term. Take the recent budget work done in Congress.I was proud to secure nearly $20 million of the budget for more than a dozen critical infrastructure projects in Northwest Washington. They are badly needed and include: Road safety improvements. A bridge replacement. Safety improvements in areas vulnerable to flooding. A water reservoir project. Upgrades at local Sheriff stations. These are just a few examples. The list goes on, and will benefit so many people across Northwest Washington. Earmarks like these allow for long-needed local projects to get off the ground, or they allow them to be completed. They are a core part of the relationship between towns across America and our federal government. This is the job that my neighbors sent me to get done in Washington, D.C.: to listen to their needs, and fight for them in the halls of Congress. I will always keep up this fight for you. Friend,

Earlier this week, we shared [an ad campaign](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVYDBn8TWGWGN2LkwPfhLN54W6J3_6X5cvPB3N22w0_M3m2ndW6N1vHY6lZ3l5W1mDdYL3fDP5FW1ZQzgc7RmZJ5W72DDlh2BNxvxW7xRNCN65cf5qV3RKrQ8RYQJgW4xKfjC1hR_G_W4nYQLT4wC_-PW5Lm6cL3YsvM6W6qr_5J8YP4SLW1XvZzn5LNm1zMqm9Cqrg2mVW3V8vFN5Mf6h3W7WdNld6lJTn9N7m_WyNs8wFdW7lD_rs7Pqm7-W88rdc_6BMYqLW7Xp7DZ10xy19W5MxFFw2xhQs1W113v5S97h_xlW2CX2Y_1lVBb7W7sSWD52pgbcfW4rF9lX2Bnlw8f70sSMx04) designed to counter-program Trump’s rallies in Michigan and Wisconsin. We’ve gotten a few requests for more information about our strategy, so I wanted to share the thinking behind that campaign. First, Michigan and Wisconsin are two states that will determine the winner in November. For Trump to be defeated, he MUST lose those states. There’s virtually no path to victory without them. Second, Trump did poorly among center-right voters in 2020. The softness in that group was absolutely essential in the last election. If there’s any hope of beating Trump again, we **must** bring these voters back into the anti-Trump coalition. **That’s where we come in.** Democratic groups will focus on keeping the pro-Biden coalition together. But that’s not our lane. We are focused on preserving and growing the anti-Trump movement by moving the needle with these center-right voters. These voters will never love Joe Biden, but we don’t need them to. We just have to remind them why they hated Trump four years ago. Elevating credible messengers—Republican voters who supported Trump before and can’t do it again—is exactly how we’ll beat him in November. Sarah Longwell

clean_body: These voters will never love Joe Biden, but we don’t need them to. We just have to remind them why they hated Trump four years ago. | Friend, Earlier this week, we shared designed to counter-program Trump’s rallies in Michigan and Wisconsin. We’ve gotten a few requests for more information about our strategy, so I wanted to share the thinking behind that campaign. First, Michigan and Wisconsin are two states that will determine the winner in November. For Trump to be defeated, he MUST lose those states. There’s virtually no path to victory without them. Second, Trump did poorly among center-right voters in 2020. The softness in that group was absolutely essential in the last election. If there’s any hope of beating Trump again, we must bring these voters back into the anti-Trump coalition. That’s where we come in. Democratic groups will focus on keeping the pro-Biden coalition together. But that’s not our lane. We are focused on preserving and growing the anti-Trump movement by moving the needle with these center-right voters. These voters will never love Joe Biden, but we don’t need them to. We just have to remind them why they hated Trump four years ago. Elevating credible messengers—Republican voters who supported Trump before and can’t do it again—is exactly how we’ll beat him in November. body:
It’ll only take 30 seconds
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1134%2E62735%2EVeMQC_)
I’ll say what we’ve known for years, Peter: **Career politicians are failing us in Washington.**
I am fed up with watching them break their promises on everything from raising wages to getting money out of politics, _and I know you are, too._
You’ve told me that directly out on the campaign trail, time and time again. Your struggles to afford life-saving health care, to choose between rent and school supplies — they’re what drive me _every single day_ to fight for the change we desperately need in Washington.
But we can’t reach everyone. As we look ahead to the primary, I’m aware that plenty of folks can’t make it out to an event to talk with me directly.
**That’s why I had my team put together a brief survey to hear directly from our supporters, no matter where they live.** Your responses will help shape our campaign’s priorities and fuel our fight for working families, retirees, veterans, students, and everyday Americans — and it only takes 30 seconds to complete.

| | Friend, It probably won’t surprise you given our name, but we think that the _Citizens United_ ruling is one of the worst Supreme Court rulings in American history. It __ opened the floodgates to allow unlimited and undisclosed dark and corporate money into our elections, and we’ve felt the ramifications of it ever since it was decided. We see the implications of _Citizens United_ in the corruption we see on the Supreme Court, in the influx of money into our elections, and in the lack of trust in our government and democracy. And we’ve seen clearly how dangerous the corruption that is running rampant through our government is. _Citizens United_ and the following influx of massive campaign spending by corporations, special interest groups, and wealthy individuals changed the way our elections function for the worse. Our democracy favors the select few who write big checks and leaves everyone else behind, all due to the _Citizens United_ decision fourteen years ago. [**Our elections need to work for everyday Americans, not just for billionaires and megadonors who write the biggest checks. We’re fighting hard to overturn**** _Citizens United_****and return power to the American people, but we can’t do it alone. If you’re ready to join us in the fight, please chip in $10 now so we can work together to get big money out of politics once and for all.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82363208/465141608/444630146?refcode=4-3-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmNTVmZjYxLWFmZjItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Um-Vc7GMQNE8apHVBF2WtdctmTXydKGUhGRKi2LJe-A=) We’ve emailed you a lot about the corruption plaguing the Supreme Court, and the _Citizens United_ ruling is the root of much of it. Although Leonard Leo and his cronies have been attempting to buy the Court and other politicians for decades, it wasn’t until the _Citizens United_ decision that they were able to really unleash the undisclosed billions of dollars to fully buy their influence on our elections and the Court. [**We’ve seen what happens when Leonard Leo and his cronies influence Supreme Court decisions and overturning**** _Roe v. Wade_****is just the beginning. We need to overturn**** _Citizens United_****now, before any more of our crucial rights get stripped away, and before the corruption in our government gets anymore out of hand. So please, contribute $10 today and join us in the fight against dark money and corruption in all forms.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82363210/465141610/444630146?refcode=4-3-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmNTVmZjYxLWFmZjItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Um-Vc7GMQNE8apHVBF2WtdctmTXydKGUhGRKi2LJe-A=) Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

body:
We are officially less than three weeks away from Summer Lee’s primary in Pennsylvania. | | | Peter, **We are officially less than three weeks away from Summer Lee’s primary in Pennsylvania** , and the attack ads are only going to get worse. A super PAC funded by GOP mega donor and billionaire, Jeff Yass, has already spent half a million dollars in the district over the past few weeks.1 And AIPAC has pledged to spend over $100 million this year to defeat progressives like her2 — a big step up from the $4 million they spent trying to knock her out of the race in 2022. **These groups wouldn’t be spending so heavily unless they thought the race was a toss-up. That’s why we’re asking for your help today, Peter.** **[Please split a donation between WFP and Summer Lee’s campaign right now, to give both of us the resources necessary to reach out to voters and combat the right-wing smear campaigns that are blanketing the airwaves.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9PdJ58eIGnv45vvkQKiMrBw-KjjBCUFP3dTfYTztpUXRUECuolPsheOSvs859OXNMW77shWPTtSl4LbJc2qJiAiRYWuTIZlr9fHrwKst7vU5_fV2fCtzxzhfBjVPV6ZBkVgLEXc0jgJxU_UyMnyfLuVbVy9BahD2bo8sHngpJXxp-ugyA9MJrNNLwvM5BZUiJnRIukxhts6Pfg2AtkR8Zp_mhJRl80u4qriUEjjhgiLh7l6JMd7w6KeR4XYvcxw7VMCReQZA-Nf9hl5oeSnvChI17Pjs_DPeXALTpMWPFOWDbBoSee8w-iFsmUvdEg4zJ/458/GQPlctu2SwWtH1Rly2gXWw/h0/h001.xbfaZcTLkpobVznsgohhiafATkYx-fSOV_w5VXnAFdw)** **[Contribute $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9PdJ58eIGnv45vvkQKiMrBw-KjjBCUFP3dTfYTztpUXRUECuolPsheOSvs859OXNMqXjS5kv9xT6rvTgolxdhZtKwiMVbOVYq1CcjgUfPhNAiAnOdzymrf9Q2V0Hf0C4z-NzRjo9giG_w60iEO1Xi-HTbYGfQJf05uAQjXJEHuDs-HWjBLDludY9HxNbgnpMG81Bn7nDfmV415AYD2arEtyLlLACUyv018zA2-XGajik6du5--gDMIxdBRQv-qqmpU8lBcDpDsyvTeX5-ZTidx32V-gmqfsdz2b5hhM5UY0_oyV0nPSoV7abepwAhRcTi/458/GQPlctu2SwWtH1Rly2gXWw/h1/h001.DuPBBSK6W3_u52Zofen2ntWsIZPevu6tsb9K89YgQsM)** Obviously we are in no position to match the bottomless pockets of a right-wing group like AIPAC. But we have a few VERY important things that they don’t:
1. **A winning message centered on policies that put workers and constituents first.** While Lee’s opponents rattle their sabers and fearmonger, we’ll continue talking to voters face to face about the biggest issues impacting them on a day to day basis.
2. **A broad grassroots coalition.** Summer Lee is backed by countless members of Congress and organizations, all with a long and storied track record of advocating for working families nationwide. Meanwhile, groups like AIPAC proudly endorse right-wing extremists on a regular basis.
3. **Support from folks like you.** Our movement to win a better future for all of us is a vibrant one. We take great pride in the fact that our average donation in 2024 is just $20. It gives us a mandate — from every single donor, volunteer, and supporter — to continue fighting for YOUR interests. Not the interests of some GOP billionaire and heir-apparent to Trump’s cabinet.3

We have our work cut out for us. clean_body: We are officially less than three weeks away from Summer Lee’s primary in Pennsylvania. | | | Peter, We are officially less than three weeks away from Summer Lee’s primary in Pennsylvania , and the attack ads are only going to get worse. A super PAC funded by GOP mega donor and billionaire, Jeff Yass, has already spent half a million dollars in the district over the past few weeks.1 And AIPAC has pledged to spend over $100 million this year to defeat progressives like her2 — a big step up from the $4 million they spent trying to knock her out of the race in 2022. These groups wouldn’t be spending so heavily unless they thought the race was a toss-up. That’s why we’re asking for your help today, Peter. Obviously we are in no position to match the bottomless pockets of a right-wing group like AIPAC. But we have a few VERY important things that they don’t: 1. A winning message centered on policies that put workers and constituents first. While Lee’s opponents rattle their sabers and fearmonger, we’ll continue talking to voters face to face about the biggest issues impacting them on a day to day basis. 2. A broad grassroots coalition. Summer Lee is backed by countless members of Congress and organizations, all with a long and storied track record of advocating for working families nationwide. Meanwhile, groups like AIPAC proudly endorse right-wing extremists on a regular basis. 3. Support from folks like you. Our movement to win a better future for all of us is a vibrant one. We take great pride in the fact that our average donation in 2024 is just $20. It gives us a mandate — from every single donor, volunteer, and supporter — to continue fighting for YOUR interests. Not the interests of some GOP billionaire and heir-apparent to Trump’s cabinet.3 We have our work cut out for us. And our window is rapidly shrinking. Thank you, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Sludge, April 2, 2024 2\. , Politico, March 3, 2024 3\. , Haaretz, March 24, 2024 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: What would happen if we won?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Cynics from all sides of the political spectrum — this is not just a left or right thing — say, “This country is not worth fighting for.”
“This system is not worth participating in. We’re just going to sit here, and stay home, and grovel in depression.”
No, we’re not.
I refuse to live that way. We refuse to live that way. Because **we reject any sort of narrative or story where we do not have power in our own future**.
We can change this country. We are changing this country.
There’s nothing to be scared of in guaranteeing healthcare to everybody in this country. There’s nothing to be scared of in a living wage. There’s nothing to be scared of in guaranteeing tuition free public colleges and universities.
This is a future not to be scared of. **What would happen if we won?**
We have to reject the politics of scarcity. We have to reject the politics of fear.
We’re going to go after — and get — what we want because we deserve it.
**Everyday people deserve a livable future.** Period.
In solidarity,
Alexandria
Alexandria is fighting for a powerful set of policies that will reshape our economy, shrink inequality, and address the climate crisis.
Our campaign is 100% people-powered. In fact, we are the #1 small-dollar funded campaign in Congress. Within a week of beginning to display “Coplen for Congress” yard signs, two of my large (and expensive) yard signs were vandalized. One was torn into little pieces and scattered around, impossible to repair. See the attached photo. Apparently, some confused soul considers our message – “United we ALL win!” – to be a threat.

The first question, of course, is who’s responsible. I simply cannot believe it is one of my Democratic opponents or their supporters. In all of the many events we’ve shared, all of the candidates and their staff have been cordial and respectful toward me, even in our disagreements. We are opponents, not enemies. That’s the Democratic way.

Nor do I believe my ultimate opponent, Scott Perry, had a direct hand in this. But I do harbor suspicions about his and Donald Trump’s supporters. The former president and MAGA Republican Overlord continues to incite political violence and suppression of free speech. He continues to threaten those who disagree with his dark vision of America and who are trying to hold him accountable for his alleged illegal behavior.

But throughout the Trump years, Scott Perry has refused to denounce political violence, political vandalism and the intimidation of voters and election workers. He has refused to stand up for the 1st Amendment’s guarantee of free speech.

**I have been in touch today with all of the Democratic candidates in this primary election. Shamaine Daniels, Mike O’Brien, Blake Lynch, John Broadhurst, and Janelle Stelson have all joined me in publicly denouncing this despicable behavior that undermines democracy. None of us will engage in it, nor will we permit those who work on our behalf to do so without consequence.**

I have not heard back from Scott Perry as to whether he will do the same.

[The next few weeks will be intense. None of us should retreat from our commitment to civility and fair play, and you can be certain that Democrats won’t. If you stand with us, add your name here to strongly denounce political vandalism and defend free speech.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82365676/465149691/-917797137?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_240404_1_1&refcode2=a58ff81a-b5f2-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&contactdata=/AP70hxhFYFmT2QwDg1/wKhRRrMe684+n4Y9APvbWgp/S7Qic/W+SZDnTBpt0Y35&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNThmZjgxYS1iNWYyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_AMNWVsXyvU3ytk4k3wO0xIu1FVVj310dClVrOij21g=&emci=d876f9b2-adf2-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=a58ff81a-b5f2-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=24669367) | | **[SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82365677/465149699/-917797137?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_240404_1_1&refcode2=a58ff81a-b5f2-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&contactdata=/AP70hxhFYFmT2QwDg1/wKhRRrMe684+n4Y9APvbWgp/S7Qic/W+SZDnTBpt0Y35&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNThmZjgxYS1iNWYyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_AMNWVsXyvU3ytk4k3wO0xIu1FVVj310dClVrOij21g=&emci=d876f9b2-adf2-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=a58ff81a-b5f2-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=24669367)**

Her Bold Move Florida

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
We have good news and bad news, Peter.

**The bad news:** Yesterday, it was announced that the Florida Supreme Court ruled that “the State Constitution’s privacy protections do not extend to abortion,” effectively **banning abortion after six weeks of pregnancy – before most women know they are pregnant.**

As stated by _The New York Times, “In paving the way for the six-week ban, the court cemented the rapid transformation of Florida, once a destination for women seeking abortions in the American South, into a place with restrictive policies akin to those in surrounding states.”_

**Florida’s new abortion ban will go into effect on May 1st.**

**But here’s the good news:** The Florida Supreme Court also ruled that a proposed constitutional amendment, which would guarantee the right to an abortion, can appear on the ballot in November.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82365996/465151084/1498473125?refcode=EM_F_240404ban_N_HBMFL_90DO_5_NG_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc0ODhkMzg5LWI1ZjItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FpiMpV85bwQOJynMQqJ4DNzGvq-cs6EpnUSw5iExdrI=)

**This is our chance, Peter:** In November, **our partners will need 60% of the vote** to secure a passage of this amendment. This is a make-or-break moment for Florida. This vote gives the power back to the VOTERS instead of anti-choice lawmakers and judges.

We are an official partner organization working with the Florida Women's Freedom Coalition. This committee has been raising the necessary dollars to (successfully!) fund the petition drive and is now working to fund voter outreach efforts + the legal fees associated with defending the amendment against the Florida GOP. [**_Every dollar_ we raise for Her Bold Move Florida is sent directly to FWFC and is used to fund this fight.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82365997/465151085/1498473125?refcode=EM_F_240404ban_N_HBMFL_90DO_5_NG_N_L2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc0ODhkMzg5LWI1ZjItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FpiMpV85bwQOJynMQqJ4DNzGvq-cs6EpnUSw5iExdrI=)

**We know Floridians want to protect the right to full reproductive healthcare, not restrict it. They’ll have a chance to make their voices heard in November – but our partners in Florida need our immediate support to get voter turnout high enough to break the 60% threshold needed to get this measure passed. Join me in protecting our children's education and defending parental rights. Your support is vital in this critical mission to safeguard the future of our next generation.

**Here's the situation:** Monday was my first major fundraising deadline of election year, and my finance team just broke the news to me: **we were 19 donations short.**

This would have been a huge blow, but we've found a way to [**extend the deadline by another 12 hours through this special donation link.**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=78fec7a4d58d46e7a6ca2d54df66d1df&_e=kiqvjdR_Bbrdt6F9wqbPJqnk1LPq-ePaknrWVtxKiM1JKLp-mnPBh86hTcxt8BsmtJHIrhwzkOkxkjP265dIL18MdzBYTqBGsFxLl8OSA2HoU5SgovbLfsNF-Ptf-3C_C2-_HxBxbFBJ0q21Eyub3K1BG_zdu4TkBooyjJ2nQQmo11F3eEDyolnqXKUaFzK7dOd6TkbnhneUxrykwJE38LbFQPWqXzNwq-XdkTXRwb6t0A0Bb34fpDZU-0nC8JBKwGUnvT_YAeDjd2bPehdNDzHPTmmU9_TblnAWmJjt3_01FqeBQph3G-ozqkh1Yhh-)

While it's impossible to add anything more to my federally mandated report...we have one more chance to make our internal goal and get back on track.

So, as a personal favor to me -- [**will you stop what you're doing and make a special, one-time donation?**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=78fec7a4d58d46e7a6ca2d54df66d1df&_e=kiqvjdR_Bbrdt6F9wqbPJqnk1LPq-ePaknrWVtxKiM1JKLp-mnPBh86hTcxt8BsmtJHIrhwzkOkxkjP265dIL18MdzBYTqBGsFxLl8OSA2HoU5SgovbLfsNF-Ptf-3C_C2-_HxBxbFBJ0q21Eyub3K1BG_zdu4TkBooyjJ2nQQlQA0-CPD6IiT2yryPUFJ74abQy0ZCmVkQbBVr6SvfzhcYbeQfApQ9ILHfR9Ocl43CRJoIGPq3EDUx_UscDgw9TosOWrQ3ImdUqGRePrCGcVEgvhpZwvfJNcCViy1m47OgnqLpL9mFA4EYX_Cu8Nxpi) Even it it's only $5...it will be the difference between completing our mission and surrendering.

I know firsthand from my time on the ground in Afghanistan: **getting the seemingly little things right matters when you're up against a determined enemy.**

My campaign, though under most people's radar right now, will be pivotal in determining who has the Senate majority, and our country is depending on your help to deliver us a victory. The Democrats know this and are already preparing to spend millions to defeat me.

Friend,

It’s no secret that our immigration system is broken and desperately in need of bipartisan legislation to fix it.

That’s exactly why President Biden and a bipartisan group of Senators led by Sen. Chris Murphy (D-CT) and Sen. James Lankford (R-OK) led the way to produce a very strong common sense bill to address migrant crossings at the U.S.-Mexico border.

**So-called “conservatives,” led by the likes of Jim Jordan, killed the bill only days after demanding new border security provisions in budget negotiations.

** Why did they do this? Because Donald Trump said the quiet part out loud: without a sense of crisis at the border, Republicans won’t be able to use immigration as a campaign issue to help Trump.

But it is clear that do-nothing Republicans like Jim Jordan, who has himself never passed a single bill into law, also have nothing to offer Americans apart from venomous hatred and xenophobia, rallying the MAGA faithful to scream about the crisis they themselves are responsible for creating.

Now, this is all we can expect from Jordan and the “Freedom” Caucus extremists: unabashed fearmongering. After a few migrants entered a school in a New Mexico border town, causing no harm and posing no threat, nutty MAGA extremists have declared that _every parent with kids in school anywhere in the country_ are somehow at grave risk:__**[](https://eqjdwl.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjUwODYzOCxcImxcIjoxMTc3MTM1NDkxMzgwNjg4NDIsXCJyXCI6MTE3NzEzNTczMzU1OTgwNzc4fSIsInMiOiJlYTMxNWI1MDkzYTk4M2E2In0)

Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1837a00b2d4940b8a507b98393ff988c&_e=wPS-NLiB1Du6AupSSvFwQ_uviUNbSXy0-W3dPp1heR5XUcKXtizzp4DjVdtnlaIaAZg1x5URtHftlHVwS8UI_YFWwAnMNcjeBB-ltJmq80AK4dpdiLr06A-6xM7yI9RirowHtlEcMmckyu78Yj95T6ObtTg7Og9UcJY3TO-GnQqwTwXa8B6hT-K0br80o5EFhr5x9taVOyLpWi-n7I7NPrcQHS5iW3fhTm3yAVrljEGWkLgnmpUMc9-ntMgXAeYePClL6-a0Z-jYXGRURrHlmuZ0Wqj2kUcONLriRz2qp7t2WA3yMXah7PzYjIXz81Ehd3OuMDbMVCUTjNiyyr_jffajVLFBq4q1S2nr5sYsAl83sKkNEjf5JYMlIJdK0yTxhgeaY9cXKCJ7DaK_ldPFQut71Aa8VfGT8qgzEbMp0rg%3D)
Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1837a00b2d4940b8a507b98393ff988c&_e=wPS-NLiB1Du6AupSSvFwQ_uviUNbSXy0-W3dPp1heR5XUcKXtizzp4DjVdtnlaIaAZg1x5URtHftlHVwS8UI_YFWwAnMNcjeBB-ltJmq80AK4dpdiLr06A-6xM7yI9RirowHtlEcMmckyu78Yj95T6ObtTg7Og9UcJY3TO-GnQqwTwXa8B6hT-K0br80o5EFhr5x9taVOyLpWi-n7I7NPrcQHS5iW3fhTm3yAVrljEGWkLgnmpUMc9-ntMgXAeYePClL6-a0Z-jYXGRURrHlmkpkD8vtRWV0v61kmJQe6v7JjmnQPcnVfd-PRP5L5NollPATwfGn41WB4tztKwj8cSaLT7forhkEx5xjFBZfsxmFMGNc_EmclBFtCaugDHRkd1p_0vpgbNlqYXYbG8FL_3QxQEFK7g-HYb2Yl4xxqF0%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

More than 2,000 people have already requested theirs, so make sure to get your set before they are all gone.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1837a00b2d4940b8a507b98393ff988c&_e=wPS-NLiB1Du6AupSSvFwQ_uviUNbSXy0-W3dPp1heR5XUcKXtizzp4DjVdtnlaIaAZg1x5URtHftlHVwS8UI_YFWwAnMNcjeBB-ltJmq80AK4dpdiLr06A-6xM7yI9RirowHtlEcMmckyu78Yj95T6ObtTg7Og9UcJY3TO-GnQqwTwXa8B6hT-K0br80o5EFhr5x9taVOyLpWi-n7I7NPrcQHS5iW3fhTm3yAVrljEGWkLgnmpUMc9-ntMgXAeYePClL6-a0Z-jYXGRURrHlmoMwhdPi3YgP8Spq8fiuOk45LRwzCQrO_e3tLkNbg_eaQM3TA1EZHF-HWEbEyYq6OJbAJb62lAmMureklW1IrLd2XAHF47anKczYjmQ1TMA7gHMSkrdSvoSHJvoj_b856fZ38EZqCcj8wettJcKraEY%3D)**

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

While Justice Democrats incumbents are under attack from right-wing
megadonor-funded Super PACs in this year’s elections, they’re not letting
it stop them from pushing for the bold, progressive change we need.

Last week, Reps. Jamaal Bowman and Delia Ramirez joined Rep. Alexandria
Ocasio-Cortez and Sen. Bernie Sanders in reintroducing the Green New Deal
for Public Housing Act to simultaneously address the dueling climate and
affordable housing crises our country faces.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/support-green-new-deal-public-housing/?source=em20240404-34147&akid=34147%2E1203867%2EZ1IlNl ]Will you add your name as a citizen cosponsor to show your support for
the Green New Deal for Public Housing today?

This comprehensive bill would create desperately needed, affordable,
environmentally-friendly public housing in addition to good-paying union
jobs.

Right now, there is not enough public housing available to meet demand,
and with a lack of federal investment, there is a $70 million backlog in
the maintenance of these affordable homes for those who need them.

Meanwhile, a record half of U.S. renters spent 30% or more of their income
on rent in 2022, leaving them with less earnings to afford other bills and
put food on the table.

Through the Green New Deal for Public Housing, necessary investments would
be made to repair public housing while making it more efficient and green.
It’s a win-win-win for workers, our most vulnerable residents in need of
affordable housing, and our environment.

One thing is clear, and that is Republicans aren’t stopping after overturning Roe v. Wade.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82369873/465165163/428766020?refcode=BLU_EM_SWC_2024-04-04_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODczMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YjFhYTk0Ni1iZmYyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ias0ufonxHLxAcVjkfT7eM1lC-YvYAc-w6Ki91ytrUk=)

| Peter,

Last week, the Supreme Court heard arguments on the case that could limit access to mifepristone, a medication that is part of a two-drug regimen for terminating unwanted pregnancies.

**This case could have repercussions right here in PA-07. More than half of abortions in the state of Pennsylvania are treated with this medication, and Pennsylvania is one of a handful of states that allows medication abortion via telehealth appointment.**

One thing is clear, and that is Republicans aren’t stopping after overturning _Roe v. Wade_. They will go after contraception and family planning (IVF) and enact further restrictions to limit women’s reproductive rights. That’s why we must enact federal legislation to safeguard reproductive rights for women across the country.

We’ve seen what happens when we leave it up to the states and the courts to decide – we’ve seen stories across the country of women having to travel hundreds of miles out of state to access lifesaving care due to extreme legislation, and as long as we don’t enact federal legislation to change it, this will remain the case.

**It’s no exaggeration to say abortion is on the ballot this fall.** Women deserve the right to bodily autonomy, and we must do everything in our power to protect it. That starts with delivering a pro-choice majority in the House this November.

**I’ve already taken steps to introduce a bill to codify IVF, and I will do everything in my power to support legislation to protect a woman’s right to choose.[_If you’re with me, I hope you’ll join my re-election campaign today to help us protect reproductive rights nationwide:_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82369874/465165165/428766020?refcode=BLU_EM_SWC_2024-04-04_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODczMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YjFhYTk0Ni1iZmYyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ias0ufonxHLxAcVjkfT7eM1lC-YvYAc-w6Ki91ytrUk=)**

I recently wrote about [how little our country's elites, particularly journalists and editors, seemed to learn](https://substack.com/redirect/d397620a-0316-4814-b9ed-e1a77443f74b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the corrupt invasion of Iraq and subsequent exposure of lies from Washington that enabled it. At the same time that America's institutions have seemed to remain criminally ignorant, however, We the people of the United States have also risen to the challenge.
Today, the peace movement repeated a feat unrivaled over the past generation. [21 years ago this month, 5,000 Bay Area residents swarmed a Lockheed Martin complex](https://substack.com/redirect/d2e960de-f20b-4eab-943f-526045a72161?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Sunnyvale, CA to shut down the facility as part of an organized direct action in which dozens of activists were arrested, and one seriously injured.
This morning, activists mobilized again to shut down the facility for the first time since then.
_None of us have the power or resources to arrest, prosecute, and imprison everyone who profits from international crime by working at a U.S. military contractor. But, with enough organization, and patience, we can at least keep them from going to work for a day._
The shut down of the Sunnyvale Lockheed Martin facility in the spring of 2003 brought together students and workers from across the bay area. It was one of the first major direct actions for which I played an organizing role, and it more or less consumed the spring of my third year in law school.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2024b5f6-89c1-47b0-a6cd-4b18efb633e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo by Brooke Anderson (@movementphotographer on Instagram)
Seeing a new generation of activists grow inspired to take similar action in the face of disturbingly similar human rights abuses offers not only an indication of dissent from the bipartisan genocide continuing to unfold in Gaza, but also a critical [escalation from mere dissent to actual resistance](https://substack.com/redirect/8bb0addf-4076-499a-b30e-642587840188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Given the militarism and international belligerence [shared](https://substack.com/redirect/05024e67-d7a2-4ee0-a76a-2dfdd958c507?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by each of the major political parties, today's action offers inspiration, and a blueprint for concerned Americans in other places who want to defend the international human rights principles that Washington & Tel Aviv have conspired to erode so dramatically.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=143275968&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQzMjc1OTY4LCJpYXQiOjE3MTIyNjE2MzgsImV4cCI6MTcxNDg1MzYzOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.OOYpnyEcTVE5Fmy7_41WpZRqHNLh3dUvvf3pMtS1ERA)
### **Returning to the scene of the crime**
International human rights abuses are criminal acts. Full stop.
But the people who pull the triggers are not the only ones responsible. The [legal precedent](https://substack.com/redirect/6e247cbe-d758-424d-8aac-006c0ccfd7d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) set by the Nuremberg trials after the allied victory in the Second World War established [strict liability for human rights abuses](https://substack.com/redirect/6e247cbe-d758-424d-8aac-006c0ccfd7d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), meaning that anyone who enables them shares legal culpability. Moreover, there is no defense: it doesn't matter who gave the orders, and it doesn't matter if someone thought there was an emergency.
Human rights violations are criminal acts. And everyone who enables them shares responsibility.
Our nation once fought a world war to establish that principle before [tragically losing it to criminals in Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/db6c8d6d-8539-4676-a992-17027ea78749?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), many of whom remain in office.
The outrageous and disturbing reality is that the ranks of criminals include nearly every elected official in Washington, [certainly Biden and senior officials](https://substack.com/redirect/1f0c0756-8dda-4fd5-9aae-afe8bdd72cc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the departments of State and Defense. They also include any number of corporate leaders and workers who earn a living by manufacturing weapons that end up in the hands of the Israeli Defense Forces.
To the extent corporations are legally considered [persons entitled to infect the political process with their own interests and capital](https://substack.com/redirect/b9a5d494-b866-4c8e-baf8-5e4fc8870acb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), they are also legal entities that should be held criminally responsible for complicity in human rights violations. Because our justice system is so co-opted that it can't recognize institutional crimes even when they grow ubiquitous, enforcing those laws falls to civilian activists.
None of us have the power or resources to arrest, prosecute, and imprison everyone who profits from international crime by working at a U.S. military contractor. But, with enough organization, and patience, we can at least keep them from going to work for a day.
### **Second verse, same as the first: a little bit louder, since the need is much worse**
This morning, activists assembled in the hours before dawn, braving not only the hostility of local law enforcement, but also a rainstorm that began as the sun rose. Those who locked down to occupy each of the three entrances to the Lockheed facility in Sunnyvale committed to staying there for hours despite remarkable inconvenience and risk to their health.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/95158469-0b08-4cf6-81af-61bdaecd8594?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Especially impressive to me was the organization behind today's event. Like those who joined us 20 years ago, participants received robust training and resources for participants in nonviolent direct action. Organizers recruited dedicated liaisons to interface with law-enforcement, as well as the press, and provided music, food, and transportation.
This is not a movement of casually committed observers, but one of a deeply rooted conviction shared across many communities.
The voices of the participants help reveal why their resistance to Washington's crimes is so critical today.
"We have gathered here to disrupt Lockheed Martin's operations and demand that the U.S. stop all arms sales to Israel," said Maramiya Yensoon. "We urge Congress and Biden to push for a permanent ceasefire, and fellow communities to take up calls for ceasefire themselves until Biden acts."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0589cc3b-dd92-4366-a760-2628cdb86735?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As participant Kaiyah Ari observed, "Our elected officials will not act quickly or boldly enough to halt the genocide. Until Congress blocks the bombs, we will."
Like a mirror, the proud conviction of today's activists reverberated with the voices of my friends & allies who joined me in organizing the action that shut down the Sunnyvale Lockheed Martin facility 21 years ago.
_This newsletter is supported by readers, rather than advertisers. To receive new posts,**sign up for a free subscription!** To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..w_1woySStAC9UbP-REXFy51GM6hygNXPN7pE5xAICmw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=143275968)
According to physicist and community organizer Mandeep Gill, "As one of the original co-organizers of the Lockheed Martin blockade that responded to the illegal invasion of Iraq in 2003, I am so very proud to see another blockade at a site which is manufacturing weapons used in a racist genocide of tens of thousands of men, women, and children in the Mideast yet again, 21 years later." Gill currently works as a research astrophysicist at the University of Minnesota, while organizing with Unidos, a community organization advancing social, racial, and economic justice.
Another organizer of the 2003 action, civil rights leader and author Valarie Kaur Brar, said, "It is painful to witness the genocidal violence in Gaza decades after my classmates and I joined a global movement to end war crimes. I am grateful and inspired to see a new generation of activists following in our footsteps, as we followed our predecessors, raising our voices for a world of justice and peace." Her most recent book, "[See No Stranger: A Memoir and Manifesto of Revolutionary Love](https://substack.com/redirect/f22d458c-d08a-4c43-ae7d-f706d8f8358e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," has been described as "a moral compass for our time" by Michelle Alexander, author of a groundbreaking 2010 book titled "[The New Jim Crow: Mass Incarceration in the Age of Colorblindness](https://substack.com/redirect/0a5a02ef-09a1-4189-94fb-67ef41fd2bbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5d57169d-9c52-422e-8626-028d916c7d34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Second year Stanford student Carlos Enrique Ramirez is exploring Urban Studies. As a student whose family originally hailed from El Salvador, he shared an especially fascinating perspective on the issues that drove him to take action today. As he explained to me:
> "Much of the immigration of Salvadorans to the United States was driven by a proxy war between the United States and Russia during the Cold War. Much of the ammunition used by the right wing government at the time was supplied through Israel. My connection with that history is deeply personal: my family had some sympathies with the opposition. My mom went to sleep hearing the noise of gunshots and bombs. My father lived in fear that one day, he might get shot, or that his house might get blown up.
> Those bombs are the same bombs that are being dropped on the Palestinian people today."
Organizers noted that Israel is continuing its criminal bombing campaign in Rafah during the holy month of Ramadan. Over 30,000 have died already, driven to early graves by a combination of political impunity in Israel, American [belligerence](https://substack.com/redirect/ea2f782f-05b4-4348-968a-4b599f834661?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) enabling it, artificial intelligence [reportedly identifying civilian targets](https://substack.com/redirect/001b8dcd-f4f8-438b-ba25-94d8663a762c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a controversial Israeli policy [encouraging](https://substack.com/redirect/f4266bf5-b8d9-4198-b2da-0892fd808b8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) civilian deaths in order to serve military objectives, and widespread [propaganda and misinformation in the international press](https://substack.com/redirect/163d2cba-5e08-4a1b-9861-b3d9f225c931?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) supporting Israel's official narrative despite the realities on the ground.
Meanwhile, the world's largest weapons manufacturer, Lockheed Martin, supplies Israel with a wide range of weapons and instruments of destruction. They include F-16 and F-35 fighter jets, Hellfire missiles, other weapons, and surveillance technology actively used in its ongoing genocide in Gaza. The company [describes](https://substack.com/redirect/28f65b69-b691-4255-b124-146d5a09796a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its F-35 Lightning II as "the most lethal" fighter jet in the world (conspicuously failing to mention its renowned [test failures](https://substack.com/redirect/da6d80ed-2329-4e85-9248-c7a3d7ab5605?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [absurd lifecycle costs](https://substack.com/redirect/c8a6e66f-cbd3-47a3-8805-298bea5e9a76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), and the company's Hellfire missiles have been recently used to assassinate Palestinian journalists and health workers, while targeting hospitals and other critical civilian infrastructure.
### **Why today 's action matters so much**
While California enjoys a progressive reputation, it is generally undeserved. While a socially liberal state, it has long supported the imperial machinations of Washington around the world. That's been true not only of the [Members of Congress elected by Californians](https://substack.com/redirect/2372b652-a3e2-4bfb-9d0d-3bd36e87c3a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to make policy in Washington in the past, but also [those chosen by the state's unfortunately ignorant voters today](https://substack.com/redirect/6024d456-1968-4470-8cd7-7435868f3f3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Santa Clara County is a particularly conservative part of California, encompassing incredibly wealthy suburbs between San Francisco and San Jose in which any number of companies maintain offices, research facilities, and headquarters. Unlike San Francisco, where organized dissent is almost facilitated by a police department that has grown quite accustomed to accommodating it, the county of Santa Clara is not nearly as frequently the site of mobilizations, and police there have a generally much more brutal reputation.
It was earned.
In 2003, when we organized the direct action at Lockheed Martin's facility in Santa Clara, a student at a local university participating in the lockdown passed out after law enforcement authorities drilled through his hand in order to remove him from the blockade and allow traffic to move through the facility's entrance.
While that story seem like a powerful disincentive to participate in direct action, it has a happy ending--at least for the young man who suffered the severe injury. I ran into him many years later on the other side of the country, and learned that he had not only gone to medical school in Kansas in the interim, but also gotten what amounted to a free medical education, effectively paid for by the county of Santa Clara as the result of a lawsuit.
The groups and individuals participating in today's action reflected a similarly diverse coalition of bay area residents drawn from the ranks of students, workers, and teachers. And they faced similar risks: this morning, a Lockheed Martin employee reportedly threatened to drive over protesters while brandishing a weapon and yelling that "Somebody's gonna die."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/61699bdd-06db-4081-b6a2-56cd9b4eb3a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Another reason that today's action is so significant is because it represents an escalation beyond declaratory marches. Rather than merely assert the principles that Washington should be following--like international legal rules that we once won a World War to create--participants in today's action took direct action at the site of a military contractor.
There are hundreds of other such facilities all across the country. One hopes others in some of those places might be watching, and growing inspired.
### The view from 20,000 feet
Biden's support for the Israeli genocide in Gaza has effectively [doomed](https://substack.com/redirect/69db2437-5b22-4496-9b06-8e2722dc50d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his [chances](https://substack.com/redirect/a3ff3238-1534-4a1a-8a3a-8ca96c9ce121?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for reelection in November. At this point, Democrats who whine about the possibility of a second Trump presidency have no plausible means of stopping it beyond [various legal processes](https://substack.com/redirect/db115fcb-dfe5-46df-b8e6-d0c5218ad60e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that could potentially disqualify him.
They, of course, are far from the first time that Democrats have pursued attempts to disqualify a figure who they [effectively created](https://substack.com/redirect/0366a350-377f-4baf-b5a1-fdf3e65aa598?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and have [politically enabled](https://substack.com/redirect/d54556bc-2f3c-4140-b69e-38abc1b491b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at every turn.
Having embraced an unapologetically genocidal president and engineered an [illegitimate process to block any challenges](https://substack.com/redirect/938d491d-ba16-4972-abd7-d54ad5ae16d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from within the party, Democrats have squandered any opportunity to claim human rights as a legitimate reason to vote for their candidate, instead of a would-be tyrant. Each of the major parties' candidates have demonstrated [outrageous disrespect for not only international human rights, but also democracy](https://substack.com/redirect/ea2f782f-05b4-4348-968a-4b599f834661?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the United States.
Of course, other candidates offer alternatives. One of them, in particular, has consistently offered a brighter vision for America while rejecting the bipartisan militarism that has poisoned our nation's once storied legacy in the world. It should come as no surprise that [Cornel West](https://substack.com/redirect/182de6e9-fb4d-4bf9-bd6c-b52262946725?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has faced [prolific smears](https://substack.com/redirect/716d7c84-afeb-4baf-a659-1abd13e370b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) throughout his campaign, or that the most effective character assassins have come from the ranks of supposedly impartial journalists. Their biases ultimately reveal their unethical commitments to the corporate political parties.
But what would a free and brave people do in the face of such corruption? When the [parties in Washington collude](https://substack.com/redirect/05024e67-d7a2-4ee0-a76a-2dfdd958c507?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and conspire to [kill women and children](https://substack.com/redirect/b845f595-bb9e-478c-b8a8-b738aa6fed2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) abroad, enabled by [newspapers bending over backwards to cover up](https://substack.com/redirect/ebbce2e5-ad97-4b61-8fa9-740e5c1dd0c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) human rights abuses and [promote propaganda peddled by Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/163d2cba-5e08-4a1b-9861-b3d9f225c931?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), what can we each possibly do?
Under such circumstances, the last line of defense for human rights [falls to us: We, the people](https://substack.com/redirect/8bb0addf-4076-499a-b30e-642587840188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### **Standing on the shoulders of giants**
Activism promoting peace in the face of a seemingly unaccountable war machine not only stands as part of a reverberating cycle across history, but has achieved remarkable victories, both in the past and present.
Two generations ago, legions of committed Americans helped end [the imperial war on Vietnam, Cambodia, and Laos](https://substack.com/redirect/eaeda670-59bd-4cb1-b742-44890a934d31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In retrospect, those international crimes were absolutely genocidal, particularly when considered in light of the subsequent events they enabled, like the brutal violence of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia that emerged as a response to the American bombing campaign and proxy war.
A generation later, activists helped expose a pattern of human rights abuses across Latin America. The ascension of George H.W. Bush to the presidency after having served as CIA Director could have portended an unending cycle of those abuses.
For better or worse, limiting him to one term may have helped end that cycle--even though, to be fair, it appears to have reemerged under later presidents. While Trump was in office, military coups conspicuously spread to countries including [Venezuela](https://substack.com/redirect/310dab5b-cabd-493f-ab05-ba213b2ff473?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Bolivia](https://substack.com/redirect/b11cfaac-00f0-4b90-a307-783490e77f44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--both of which harbor vast natural resources (including oil and lithium) for which industries in the United States salivate.
No one has yet leaked documents proving the CIA and Pentagon's role in those coups. I perceive that discovery as a matter of time. Had I had been elected to Congress when I ran to replace a [corrupt oligarch whose representation of San Francisco continues to prioritize the interests of Wall Street and the Pentagon](https://substack.com/redirect/2372b652-a3e2-4bfb-9d0d-3bd36e87c3a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one of my first agendas would have been to investigate that history.
I wish, with all my heart, that our elected officials in Washington deserved their positions or cared to honor their oaths of office. Understanding that they don't, however, I feel tremendous pride in the fellow voices rising across this country to challenge its criminal hypocrisy in defense of international human rights, precious--and precarious--communities around the world, and the lives of [innocent civilians subjected to arbitrary state violence](https://substack.com/redirect/07188f49-c73c-4f22-a8e9-3bb41920927c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
