One of them, in particular, has consistently offered a brighter vision for America while rejecting the bipartisan militarism that has poisoned our nation's once storied legacy in the world. It should come as no surprise that has faced throughout his campaign, or that the most effective character assassins have come from the ranks of supposedly impartial journalists. Their biases ultimately reveal their unethical commitments to the corporate political parties. But what would a free and brave people do in the face of such corruption? When the and conspire to abroad, enabled by human rights abuses and , what can we each possibly do? Under such circumstances, the last line of defense for human rights . Standing on the shoulders of giants Activism promoting peace in the face of a seemingly unaccountable war machine not only stands as part of a reverberating cycle across history, but has achieved remarkable victories, both in the past and present. Two generations ago, legions of committed Americans helped end . In retrospect, those international crimes were absolutely genocidal, particularly when considered in light of the subsequent events they enabled, like the brutal violence of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia that emerged as a response to the American bombing campaign and proxy war. A generation later, activists helped expose a pattern of human rights abuses across Latin America. The ascension of George H.W. Bush to the presidency after having served as CIA Director could have portended an unending cycle of those abuses. For better or worse, limiting him to one term may have helped end that cycle--even though, to be fair, it appears to have reemerged under later presidents. While Trump was in office, military coups conspicuously spread to countries including and of which harbor vast natural resources (including oil and lithium) for which industries in the United States salivate. No one has yet leaked documents proving the CIA and Pentagon's role in those coups. I perceive that discovery as a matter of time. Had I had been elected to Congress when I ran to replace a , one of my first agendas would have been to investigate that history. I wish, with all my heart, that our elected officials in Washington deserved their positions or cared to honor their oaths of office. Understanding that they don't, however, I feel tremendous pride in the fellow voices rising across this country to challenge its criminal hypocrisy in defense of international human rights, precious--and precarious--communities around the world, and the lives of . | | With elections across the country heating up, I wanted to reach out to you about Andrea Salinas' race here in Oregon's 6th Congressional District and share a little about why she's in this fight and why she needs our support. Holding her seat is critical to taking back the House in 2024. Andrea's dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job that provided a path into the middle class for her family. Growing up, Andrea saw that with persistence and determination, you can achieve your goals. It took her seven years to graduate college – and juggling multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but she put in the hours and earned that degree. After Andrea's daughter was born 18 years ago, she knew she wanted to leave the world a better place for her daughter – just as her family had done for her. That's why she stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a state legislator, she successfully fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation's most progressive paid family leave bill. **And now, she's brought that same level of determination and work ethic to Congress.** She's an invaluable ally for Oregonians in the House, always fighting for working families to ensure we all have the health care, reproductive freedoms, quality education, clean air and water, good-paying jobs, and civil rights we deserve. Andrea's race is shaping up to be one of this year's most competitive elections, and Mike Johnson and Republican dark money already have her as a top target in 2024. She's counting on grassroots supporters like you to help us defend this seat so she can keep fighting for us. Prepare for some laughs as Mark hilariously compares Denish's TV news performance to the infamous Col. Nathan Jessup from "A Few Good Men." The resemblance is uncanny!
[Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=23eff22703&e=567664f14c)

Plus, Jay predicts how the immigration issue may impact Biden's future.

Friend -- This Friday, April 5th at 8 pm, EIR Editor Paul Gallagher will give an important insight into the experience of the Irish regarding the current situation in Gaza, and the LaRouche proposal for an "Oasis Plan." How could the "Oasis Plan"-- first outlined by LaRouche in 1975 after the 1973 Yom Kippur War and proposed simultaneously with the LaRouche IDB (International Development Bank) proposal-- work in Southwest Asia today? How do we end the carnage, retaliation, revenge, genocide and colonial horror permanently? Consider the case of Ireland. Today, Ireland is rivaling South Africa in its demands for immediate ceasefire and its denunciation of the genocidal acts of Israel in Gaza. The history of how the Irish finally ended, and then recovered from, a British genocide, tells us why Ireland supports Palestinians now; but more importantly, why the Schiller Institute’s Oasis Plan economic development outline is so essential to achieving peace in Southwest Asia. The economic development given by the Shannon River Scheme and other smaller works was essential to help stabilize the period of a “two-state solution” (the Republic and Ulster) which was very uneasy to put it very mildly. But again, we see that economic development is the essential path to peace. Join the Sare Symposium on Friday, April 5th at 8 pm for this important discussion. clean_body: Hi Peter, The Child Tax Credit expansion bill is a critical step toward reducing child poverty and supporting working families — but after passing in the House, the bill is still being held up in the Senate. It’s past time we end the exclusion that prevents working-class families from qualifying for benefits under the current Child Tax Credit. April is Care Workers Recognition Month, and while we’re lifting workers and families up, we need our leaders to do the same. That means prioritizing legislation like the Child Tax Credit expansion, because it’s unacceptable for families making $400,000 to receive higher benefits than families earning $15,000 a year. And since domestic workers, who are critical to the care workforce, make an average wage of $13‐14 per hour, many earn too little to qualify for any benefits at all. The expanded proposal will end these cruel exclusions and give financial support to over 3 million children in low‐income families. Thank you for taking action, Care in Action

name: Ellen Laitinen
subject: Peter Hernandez for Congress update
body:
Hello Everyone,

I wanted to connect with you about some things needed for Peter Hernandez’s
Campaign. We just had a zoom call with Peter to give us an update. He did
well during the primary election and is continuing to build momentum. Peter
let us know that he is targeting Mid-May, around the 20th to begin hitting
the ground on canvassing, putting up signs, and making donor calls, etc.

If you would like to volunteer to help, here is a list of things needed:

*Canvassing*:

· People willing to canvass and what area (i.e. San Jose,
Watsonville, Salinas, Hollister, San Martin, Morgan Hill, Gilroy)

· Canvassing team leaders

· Canvassing Team Leader - Coordinator

*Signs:*

· People willing to put up signs

· Signage Coordinator

*Fundraising:*

· People willing to make donor phone calls

*Phone Bank:*

· People willing to make campaign calls

· Scheduler for the Phone Bank

*Campaign Event Coordinator/Personal Assist for Peter – *Someone to shadow
Peter as he attends events.

Please let me know if you have any questions and/or are willing to
volunteer.

At the end of April, Peter is making a campaign trip to Washington DC and
will have an update for us when he returns. The next Zoom call will be on
May 3 at 6pm.

Thank you for your consideration and look forward to seeing you on May 3rd.

Ellen Laitinen

Volunteer Coordinator, Peter Hernandez for Congress

# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Likely voters hold pessimistic view toward state’s future, government in poll entering election year**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [BY B](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)RIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
A large swath of voters may be concerned with the direction of the state and with items ranging from tax burden to cost of living and education, painting a pessimistic picture in an election year, [a poll conducted in late 2023 finds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The Colorado Polling Institute survey finds 43.1% of likely voters believe the state [to be on the wrong track](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with 67% of Republicans and 45% of unaffiliated voters holding that view. Half of those who have resided in the state for at least 20 years believe Colorado is on the wrong track. Only 50.4% of likely voters surveyed believe the state is on the right track. The poll was taken among 621 voters with a margin of error of 3.8%. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Gabe Evans in CD8 among 20 ‘Trailblazers’ endorsed by Top GOP super PAC for ‘proven track records’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Congressional Leadership Fund (CLF) announced its first round of ["trailblazer" endorsements for the 2024 election cycle](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aiming to bolster Republican efforts to expand their slim House majority.

* Among the 20 endorsed candidates is [Gabe Evans from Colorado's 8th district](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), recognized for his proven ability to connect with voters in battleground districts.

* The selected candidates will receive financial support from CLF's Trailblazers Fund, established to fund high-priority congressional campaigns. CLF President Dan Conston emphasized the importance of supporting candidates with [tangible achievements and strong character](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to secure and grow the House Majority in November.

* With a slim majority and recent departures among GOP lawmakers, [strategic investments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in House GOP pickup opportunities become crucial for the fall election.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Colorado Republicans: Bill banning lawmakers’ guns from Capitol is unconstitutional**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Senate Republicans in Colorado argue that [Senate Bill 131](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aiming to [ban firearms in certain locations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) including the state Capitol, is unconstitutional.

* Originally intended to prohibit firearms in 19 "[sensitive spaces](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)," including schools and parks, the bill was narrowed down in a Senate Judiciary Committee to focus mainly on colleges, universities, and schools, along with local government offices and polling locations.

* The modified bill, however, would extend the ban to virtually anywhere in the state Capitol, effectively prohibiting lawmakers from carrying weapons into legislative spaces. While Democrats emphasize the need to address gun violence on college campuses, Republicans express skepticism about the bill's [efficacy and its potential impact on safety](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), particularly in legislative spaces.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Lauren Boebert treated for blood clot in leg, expects ‘full recovery’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert underwent a successful medical procedure to [remove a blood clot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from her leg on Tuesday, diagnosed with May-Thurner syndrome.

* Doctors inserted a stent to restore blood flow, and Boebert is [expected to recover fully](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) without significant long-term health concerns. Boebert canceled a speaking engagement but plans to resume campaigning soon.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Unleash responsible energy production in Colorado, kill Senate Bill 24-159**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BOBBIE DANIELS, [RMV GUEST COLUMNIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Mesa County Board of Commissioners opposes [Senate Bill 24-159](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) banning new oil and gas production in Colorado, citing concerns about increased poverty and lower living standards.

* The [bill's approach is criticized](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for potentially harming economic resilience and innovation, emphasizing the importance of property rights and free trade.

* Proponents are urged to [reconsider the bill's impact](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on Colorado's economy and global energy markets, highlighting the state's role in promoting economic progress and responsible energy production.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[Mary Bradfield qualifies for ballot in El Paso County’s House District 21 seat](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | EL PASO COUNTY | APRIL 3** _Mary Bradfield, a Republican seeking re-election to House District 21 in El Paso County, has qualified for the primary ballot, the Colorado Secretary of State’s office announced Wednesday._ **[Rep. Anthony Hartsook’s massage trafficking bill advances in House committee hearing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | APRIL 3** _A bill by Rep. Anthony Hartsook, R-Parker, which would add certain mandatory criminal background investigation requirements of massage facilities in an effort to curb human trafficking, advanced Tuesday in the Colorado House._ [**El Paso County Republicans Caldwell and VanderWerf qualify for ballot**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | EL PASO COUNTY | APRIL 2** _The petitions of two more Republican candidates have been verified by the Colorado Secretary of State’s office, qualifying them for a place on the primary ballot._ [**Mesa County to partner through $300K grant to improve mental health care access**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY RMV STAFF | MESA COUNTY | APRIL 2** _Appropriated by Senate Bill 22-196, a $300,000 grant from the State of Colorado has allowed Mesa County Behavioral Health to collaborate with Mind Springs Health to enhance access to mental health care in Western Colorado._ [**Sloan: Biden’s betrayal of Israel in war with Hamas**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY KELLY SLOAN | NATIONAL | APRIL 2** _Back in October, in the stunned aftermath of the worst collective massacre of Jews since the Holocaust, Presideent Joe Biden told the Israelis and the world that the U.S. would stand by them._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Take a look: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82373828/465176970/1512152448?refcode=mw_em_240404_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTk3YmY3NC1jYmYyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2aFvMg3ZDJoey-f1QqfrPi6GOREah2JgHeLPzoGruWA=) And across the state, Virginians all said the same thing:**They want a government that puts cynical partisanship aside and focuses on delivering real results on the issues that matter most.** Whether it was in Harrisonburg, Winchester, Middleburg, or Buena Vista, Virginians told me they’re tired of Republicans stalling progress in the name of party loyalty. I want to expand a little more on the needs that I heard from folks on the road, Derek, but before I do, __[**I want to ask if you can chip in $5 today to help us kick off our April fundraising efforts?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82373829/465176971/1512152448?refcode=mw_em_240404_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTk3YmY3NC1jYmYyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2aFvMg3ZDJoey-f1QqfrPi6GOREah2JgHeLPzoGruWA=)__ Here’s what Virginians are looking for from congressional leaders:
* Comprehensive treatment for mental health issues
* Affordable housing
* More child care funding
* Increased local economic development and job creation
* Solutions to the terrible fentanyl epidemic

Dear Peter,
Our founding fathers deemed freedom of speech so paramount that they placed it at the forefront of the Constitution, understanding that all other rights hinge upon it.
**A government that has the capacity to silence its opponents has the power to commit any kind of atrocity.**
We witnessed the alarming beginnings of such power abuse during the pandemic when our government initiated and actively engaged in the censorship of social media speech.
_This was a seismic shift in American governance._ Once the powers-that-be realized the public's complacency, and that there would be no media uproar, they brazenly violated other constitutional rights.
They shuttered countless businesses nationwide without due process or just compensation, a direct violation of the Fifth Amendment.
They trampled upon the remaining pillars of the First Amendment, curbing freedom of worship by closing down churches and synagogues across the country without scientific rationale or democratic procedure.
All the safeguards of the democratic process that I've spent four decades defending were discarded with impunity.
**The abuses of power from the highest levels of our government continues to this day.** [The repercussions are dire, and the urgency cannot be overstated. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=preserving_4_4_24_nd1&n=5)

I am the only candidate in this race who has steadfastly championed the ideals of free speech, individual liberty, and the protection of constitutional rights.
Now, more than ever, it is imperative to elect leaders who will fiercely defend the principles that define our democracy.
However, the truth is that meaningful change cannot come without resources. Unlike my opponents, who benefit from automatic ballot access and government-funded Secret Service protection, our campaign faces daunting financial barriers.
[We must raise tens of millions of dollars to secure ballot access and provide adequate protection.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=preserving_4_4_24_nd1&n=7)

A government that has the capacity to silence its opponents has the power to commit any kind of atrocity. We witnessed the alarming beginnings of such power abuse during the pandemic when our government initiated and actively engaged in the censorship of social media speech. This was a seismic shift in American governance. Once the powers-that-be realized the public's complacency, and that there would be no media uproar, they brazenly violated other constitutional rights. They shuttered countless businesses nationwide without due process or just compensation, a direct violation of the Fifth Amendment. They trampled upon the remaining pillars of the First Amendment, curbing freedom of worship by closing down churches and synagogues across the country without scientific rationale or democratic procedure. All the safeguards of the democratic process that I've spent four decades defending were discarded with impunity. The abuses of power from the highest levels of our government continues to this day. I am the only candidate in this race who has steadfastly championed the ideals of free speech, individual liberty, and the protection of constitutional rights. Now, more than ever, it is imperative to elect leaders who will fiercely defend the principles that define our democracy. However, the truth is that meaningful change cannot come without resources. | Hi there, it’s Sam.

I know we send a lot of emails, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you more about myself and why I’m running for Congress.

Growing up, I had access to all the opportunities given to me because my mom pulled herself out of poverty and into the middle class through education. My mom is my hero. She was able to make ends meet, and build a better life for herself and our family. But so many families struggle to make ends meet and don’t get a quality education just because of where they live.

Right now, the zip code you grow up in is the single biggest factor in determining if you will succeed in life. It shouldn’t be this way. Every child deserves the opportunity to achieve their full potential.

So, I was inspired to join Teach for America after college, which led me to teach in one of Dallas’ most underprivileged schools. Then, I wanted to do more to help our students, so I became the youngest principal in Dallas ISD, leading a school where students are able to better prepare themselves for the future.

Now, I’m running for Congress because what our country needs most right now is a new generation of leadership to build a brighter future for everyone, in every zip code.

body:
If I don’t act to protect my family, who will?! | | | Hi Peter, To feel confident, empowered, and in a community of people who understand me is something I’ve looked for. ✊And I found that political home here with The Squad. Growing up, there was always a lot of fear and uncertainty as a member of a mixed status family. I felt so much anxiety not knowing if today will be the day I get the call that my parents have been detained by ICE. During the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, I joined The Squad and found a safe space to link up with like minded people ready to dream big and win protections for our families. 🤩Now that I’ve built power with The Squad, I feel certain that we’re the ones we’ve been waiting for. Together we can keep each other safe and fight for a future where we can all thrive. **[I’m sharing my story with you today to welcome you to become a part of our community, Peter.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhy-pu9woVQPT-iJuho8iSHm26TIhIgtlkMx08x4YzaeThU7gaLRDsLZW2LSo_66R4GZCnFj2DQZOO-QiWlWTfTvJ-C896W8j8NpFVIkvWWuBfyvJOxFFG4xuGo4Q21anAamxv9VJNzZiLzaQvn7oYn0xSEuhpLrmP6PhQh-2gmAt3JVmjypZ7sgI6IEiqNOHfUK87B_7PYHa8G1hx3Bh9aKxG10N8PZ351hYP70BN1mFhM60mmP-xeBWMZxL3My6E5A/458/QWPOWuw_RsWdy4O8-u8Pjw/h0/h001.8ev7bI0o-xf2kT-tNtPUTv0zAR_3EkeEnYqyk1sEcw8)** Check it out below! It's tax season, a time that fills millions of Americans with dread as they pay out hundreds of dollars to tax prep companies like TurboTax, and spend hours filing their taxes.
It doesn't have to be this way.
Filing taxes should be free and easy, which is why I pushed the IRS to create a new Direct File program. **The program is officially in pilot mode for eligible taxpayers in Arizona, California, Florida, Massachusetts, Nevada, New Hampshire, New York, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, and Wyoming.[Learn more here.](https://substack.com/redirect/4b8c6aa2-175e-425d-8cda-f7a0b43a625d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
But now, big tax prep companies aren't happy about the potential of being cut out of the tax filing process for families with simple tax needs, so they've been busy trying to kill this program and thwart any expansion ⤵️.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5b64d755-2454-4cb3-aaf8-a8ba8f9576b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let's back up for a second: Tax prep companies have spent *decades* lobbying Congress to ensure we didn't fix this broken system, allowing them to continue collecting big payouts from American taxpayers.
In 2002, Intuit, H&R Block, and other big tax prep companies came to an agreement with the IRS. These companies would provide free filing services to Americans whose annual income was below a certain level. In exchange, the IRS was banned from creating its own free file system.
But even that wasn't enough for these corporations. These companies have [used deceptive techniques to trick people into paying to file, even when this law means they shouldn't have had to pay.](https://substack.com/redirect/faa774fd-98fe-40fb-8762-646c3de3975d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Reports found that Intuit, the parent company of TurboTax, purposefully suppressed its own Free File product, even adding website code to block the Free File page from showing up in search engines. And companies have used manipulative marketing techniques to trick customers into paying to file even when they qualify for a cost-free option.
The greed kept going: Without the prosper consent or disclosures, some of these corporations sent taxpayers' personal data--from how much they made to their filing status--to big tech companies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d8217171-566b-436f-b098-03d5ddf1b187?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Tax prep companies are a perfect example of why we need effective government oversight that holds corporations accountable.** In most cases, the IRS already has the information it needs to collect your taxes or issue a refund, but tax prep companies have made themselves a well paid middle man.
This IRS free file tool is an exciting step in the right direction. Now, it's up to lawmakers and regulators to keep holding these corporations' feet to the fire and ensure they don't continue cheating Americans.
Katie Porter

Each year, we observe Earth Month to celebrate the planet we call home and build support for stronger measures to protect it from threats like climate change. |

Happy Earth Month! Each year, we observe Earth Month to celebrate the planet we call home and build support for stronger measures to protect it from threats like climate change. Sarah knows how important this work is — she’s worked to cut emissions and protect our environment in the State Senate, and in Congress, she’ll work to ensure federal action so we can pass on a healthy, sustainable planet to future generations. Delaware is the nation’s **lowest-lying state** , making climate change an even more urgent threat to our home than many other places. And while the Inflation Reduction Act marked the most profound attempt to rescue our climate in history, Sarah knows how important it is that we build on that progress. That’s why she’ll fight to increase investment in **renewable energy** , make **green technologies** affordable and accessible for consumers and businesses, and ensure that the **sustainable industries** of the future employ a local and unionized workforce. But first we need to win this election in November. Each year, we observe Earth Month to celebrate the planet we call home and build support for stronger measures to protect it from threats like climate change. Sarah knows how important this work is — she’s worked to cut emissions and protect our environment in the State Senate, and in Congress, she’ll work to ensure federal action so we can pass on a healthy, sustainable planet to future generations. Delaware is the nation’s lowest-lying state , making climate change an even more urgent threat to our home than many other places. And while the Inflation Reduction Act marked the most profound attempt to rescue our climate in history, Sarah knows how important it is that we build on that progress. That’s why she’ll fight to increase investment in renewable energy , make green technologies affordable and accessible for consumers and businesses, and ensure that the sustainable industries of the future employ a local and unionized workforce. National MAGA Republicans, Led by House Speaker Mike Johnson, Descend on CA-47 to Highlight Baugh’s Campaign, Making Clear the Importance of this Race | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fc279c94ed1e/scott-baughs-far-right-allegiances-illustrated-at-newport-beach-fundraiser-15672871?e=7017cc100e)

---
| | **For Immediate Release:** April 4, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Scott Baugh's Far-Right Allegiances Illustrated at Newport Beach Fundraiser**
_National MAGA Republicans, Led by House Speaker Mike Johnson, Descend on CA-47 to Highlight Baugh’s Campaign, Making Clear the Importance of this Race_ **NEWPORT BEACH, CA** — National MAGA Republicans made clear their strong ties to fellow Trumpist Scott Baugh, the Republican candidate for California’s 47th Congressional District running against Democratic State Senator Dave Min, by hosting a lavish fundraiser featuring House Speaker Mike Johnson last night in Newport Beach, right in the heart of CA-47.

Speaker Johnson, known for his advocacy of a total abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the woman, represents the kind of extremist ideology that Baugh has pledged his support to. It's hardly unexpected, considering Baugh has fully embraced Johnson's MAGA agenda, advocating for an [absolute ban on abortion](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b1ecd8433b&e=7017cc100e) and opposition to safeguarding [same-sex marriage rights](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=51bfa76fe6&e=7017cc100e).

**“Scott Baugh cozying up to Speaker Mike Johnson in Newport Beach isn’t just about** endorsements– it’s a clear signal that CA-47 is ground zero in the fight for the House,” said Min campaign spokeswoman, Amelia Matier. **“Baugh’s connections to white nationalists and his backing by groups against abortion and LGBTQ+ rights fit right into Johnson’s MAGA Congressional playbook. This isn’t just another race; it’s where we draw the line. Electing Dave Min means rejecting that divisive, harmful agenda and moving forward with leadership that genuinely reflects our district's values” **

Throughout his political career, Scott Baugh has shown his total disregard for the rights or concerns of Orange County families, or for that matter, the laws of California and the United States of America. Notably, under his leadership as the Chair of the Orange County Republican Party, nearly [600 residents](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c70a1a03df&e=7017cc100e) found their voter registrations altered without consent, culminating in 12 arrests. His legal troubles didn't end there; [Baugh faced indictment](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c5f0098047&e=7017cc100e) on 20 criminal charges, including four felony counts, of manipulating election results, campaign finance violations and [persuading someone to commit perjury](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ac4dbfdffd&e=7017cc100e).

This disregard for ethical governance and community welfare speaks to Baugh's broader political agenda, which eschews practical results for working Americans in favor of stoking divisive cultural wars. Rather than focus on education, public safety or economic growth– Baugh remains committed to being another culture war conspirator in Washington D.C.. He’s already gotten off to a head start – incoherently stating the “[war on wokeness](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=2fc8152474&e=7017cc100e)” was more dangerous than 9/11 and World War II.

In stark contrast, California's 47th Congressional District has the opportunity to elect Dave Min, a candidate whose credentials and actions speak volumes about his commitment to the community. As a dedicated advocate for Orange County, a first-generation Korean American, a former business law professor, and a staunch supporter of reproductive rights, Min brings a nuanced understanding of the issues facing Southern California families. During the financial crisis, Min fought to hold Wall Street accountable and to help stabilize our economy. During his time in the State Senate – where he represented 80% of CA-47 – Min’s legislative achievements span from enshrining abortion rights in the California Constitution and bolstering protections for domestic violence survivors, to banning gun sales on state property and pioneering initiatives to combat our climate crisis.

A former University of California Irvine Law Professor, Min has spent his career in public service fighting for the American Dream. After graduating from Harvard Law School right after the Enron and Worldcom accounting scandals, Min turned down high-paying corporate law jobs to instead prosecute corporate fraud at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). He went on to serve as an economic policy director on Capitol Hill, fighting for economic fairness and opportunity during the height of the mortgage crisis, before coming back home to California to teach at what was then a brand new law school at UC Irvine. During his time in the California Legislature, Senator Min has been a champion on women’s reproductive rights, gun safety, and climate justice in the California Legislature, and he has also been a stalwart leader on public safety and education issues, earning the endorsements of Orange County’s Police Officers, Deputy Sheriffs, Firefighters, and Teachers. ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

# 2024 April e-newsletter
---
|
---
|
---
| **Ending loneliness campaign will be a model for entire nation**
---
| Dear friends, I was honored to be a panelist at the ninth event in the Peninsula Family Service (PFS) Thought Leader Series with the theme of Overcoming the Epidemic of Loneliness: A Community Challenge Wednesday, April 3 following San Mateo County being the first in the nation to declare loneliness a public health crisis in January. This is the beginning of a broad campaign to overcome loneliness and connect those living in isolation like never before that I imagine will be a model for the Bay Area, state and even the nation to follow. We know that loneliness is detrimental to the mental and physical wellness of many people of all ages and our efforts in the county have been applauded by the U.S. Surgeon General Dr. Vivek Murthy who last year identified loneliness in the United States as an epidemic.
---
Although I’m not an expert on loneliness others are and I see it as my mission to uplift their work and fight for the resources necessary to help all of us overcome loneliness. This thought leader event brought together experts including UCSF professor of Geriatrics Dr. Carla Perissinotto, Peninsula Family Service CEO Heather Cleary, Peninsula Health Care District CEO Ana Pulido and UCSF assistant professor of Medicine Dr. Ashwin Kotwal to discuss the challenges we face related to loneliness and solutions to overcome loneliness and the issues that relate to it. Read the Mercury News article about the event here: [https://www.mercurynews.com/2024/04/03/isolation-san-mateo-county-million-to-fight-loneliness-april-2024/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=d1636933ff&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **New crosswalk improves safety for students at two schools ** It was exciting to host a ribbon cutting Wednesday, March 26 to unveil the completion of the $2 million Broadmoor Safe Routes to School Pedestrian Improvements Project between two neighborhood-serving schools. I was able to help secure the funding as I serve on the Metropolitan Transportation Commission, which funded the project. The project was prompted by Garden Village Elementary School Principal Nuala O’Sullivan-Haley, pictured above, who advocated for the safety of her students and families who walk to school. Some motorists have been treating the streets around the schools like racetracks and hopefully this project will put an end to that. This is the first major infrastructure project in unincorporated Broadmoor in decades. But we’re not done yet, the next step I’m working on is to reduce the speed limit in the area when school is in session down to 15 mph. The Broadmoor Safe Routes to School Pedestrian Improvements Project includes a raised midblock crosswalk, bulb-outs, ADA curb ramps, pedestrian and traffic signals, as well as road surfacing treatment and striping improvements near Garden Village Elementary School and Benjamin Franklin Intermediate School to increase visibility, shorten crossing distances and serve as traffic calming features to slow traffic.
---
---
| **Fierce advocate for older adults honored by county as she retires** The county was proud to present an honorary resolution to the longtime Director of Aging and Adult Services Lisa Mancini at a retirement party March 21. The work she did at Aging and Adult Services, for the Commissions on Aging and Disabilities has been phenomenal and impacted thousands of lives over her 25 years with the county. I remember my first year in office in 2017 when we were exploring the Age-Friendly Cities concept and how to bring it to the county. Mancini helped our office get the concept off the ground. And now 7 years later most cities in the county are now certified Age-friendly by the World Health Organization This initiative will continue to address the pressing needs of older adults and create environments in every city to be more welcoming to our rapidly aging population. And then there was COVID and a global pandemic that especially put older adults at risk of serious illness and death. Mancini rose to the occasion recognizing that the shelter in place order would create a serious need to feed our older population, who were stuck at home and often isolated. She championed the Great Plates Delivered program, a $50 million investment that rescued 80 local restaurants from closure and helped 4,500 older adults stay healthy with fresh hot meals. It was a rescue program to keep older frail adults from going hungry while rescuing small restaurants from certain closure. When the County studied the impact of Great Plates Delivered on these businesses, we found that 87% would have gone out of business if it wasn’t for Great Plates Delivered. I believe feeding the hungry in this manner saved hundreds of jobs but most importantly helped to save lives. Congratulations to Lisa on her retirement and welcome to Lee Pullen, who was named the new director of Aging and Adult Services on March 25.
---
| **A message to social media companies: Follow your own rules to end hate speech** The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors passed a resolution I sponsored urging social media platforms such as Facebook and X to enforce their own community standards and guidelines to prevent and eliminate content promoting guns, violence, hate and other content that may be harmful on March 26. My office collaborated with Dr. Karen North, professor of Digital Social Media at the USC Annenberg School on the presentation of the resolution to the Board of Supervisors. The rabbit holes on social media run deep and are filled with content that promotes violence and hate that not only harms children as is widely noted but also adults who find refuge in consuming and spreading hateful and divisive content. Facebook has community standards and says it will remove content that is inauthentic, unsafe or degrading to others but its simply not following its own rules. The consequences of not enforcing these guidelines can lead to violent outcomes and have severe mental health impacts on all of us. Dr. North previously worked in the Clinton Administration in the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, and before that she worked for Rep. Edward Markey, Chairman of the U.S. House of Representatives Subcommittee on Telecommunications and Finance. Dr. North said to the Board: “... thinking about today’s resolution, we should all consider the consequences of portraying guns, violence, and gun violence in a manner that amplifies violence, hatred, and vindictiveness, and ask ourselves if we could take steps to address the use of social media to promote violence.”
---
| **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ecb8737949&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org)
---
| **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. clean_body: | | | | | | | 2024 April e-newsletter | | | Ending loneliness campaign will be a model for entire nation | Dear friends, I was honored to be a panelist at the ninth event in the Peninsula Family Service (PFS) Thought Leader Series with the theme of Overcoming the Epidemic of Loneliness: A Community Challenge Wednesday, April 3 following San Mateo County being the first in the nation to declare loneliness a public health crisis in January. This is the beginning of a broad campaign to overcome loneliness and connect those living in isolation like never before that I imagine will be a model for the Bay Area, state and even the nation to follow. We know that loneliness is detrimental to the mental and physical wellness of many people of all ages and our efforts in the county have been applauded by the U.S. Surgeon General Dr. Vivek Murthy who last year identified loneliness in the United States as an epidemic. Although I’m not an expert on loneliness others are and I see it as my mission to uplift their work and fight for the resources necessary to help all of us overcome loneliness. This thought leader event brought together experts including UCSF professor of Geriatrics Dr. Carla Perissinotto, Peninsula Family Service CEO Heather Cleary, Peninsula Health Care District CEO Ana Pulido and UCSF assistant professor of Medicine Dr. Ashwin Kotwal to discuss the challenges we face related to loneliness and solutions to overcome loneliness and the issues that relate to it. Read the Mercury News article about the event here: | New crosswalk improves safety for students at two schools It was exciting to host a ribbon cutting Wednesday, March 26 to unveil the completion of the $2 million Broadmoor Safe Routes to School Pedestrian Improvements Project between two neighborhood-serving schools. I was able to help secure the funding as I serve on the Metropolitan Transportation Commission, which funded the project. The project was prompted by Garden Village Elementary School Principal Nuala O’Sullivan-Haley, pictured above, who advocated for the safety of her students and families who walk to school. Some motorists have been treating the streets around the schools like racetracks and hopefully this project will put an end to that. This is the first major infrastructure project in unincorporated Broadmoor in decades. But we’re not done yet, the next step I’m working on is to reduce the speed limit in the area when school is in session down to 15 mph. The Broadmoor Safe Routes to School Pedestrian Improvements Project includes a raised midblock crosswalk, bulb-outs, ADA curb ramps, pedestrian and traffic signals, as well as road surfacing treatment and striping improvements near Garden Village Elementary School and Benjamin Franklin Intermediate School to increase visibility, shorten crossing distances and serve as traffic calming features to slow traffic. | Fierce advocate for older adults honored by county as she retires The county was proud to present an honorary resolution to the longtime Director of Aging and Adult Services Lisa Mancini at a retirement party March 21. The work she did at Aging and Adult Services, for the Commissions on Aging and Disabilities has been phenomenal and impacted thousands of lives over her 25 years with the county. I remember my first year in office in 2017 when we were exploring the Age-Friendly Cities concept and how to bring it to the county. Mancini helped our office get the concept off the ground. And now 7 years later most cities in the county are now certified Age-friendly by the World Health Organization This initiative will continue to address the pressing needs of older adults and create environments in every city to be more welcoming to our rapidly aging population. And then there was COVID and a global pandemic that especially put older adults at risk of serious illness and death. Mancini rose to the occasion recognizing that the shelter in place order would create a serious need to feed our older population, who were stuck at home and often isolated. She championed the Great Plates Delivered program, a $50 million investment that rescued 80 local restaurants from closure and helped 4,500 older adults stay healthy with fresh hot meals. It was a rescue program to keep older frail adults from going hungry while rescuing small restaurants from certain closure. When the County studied the impact of Great Plates Delivered on these businesses, we found that 87% would have gone out of business if it wasn’t for Great Plates Delivered. I believe feeding the hungry in this manner saved hundreds of jobs but most importantly helped to save lives. Congratulations to Lisa on her retirement and welcome to Lee Pullen, who was named the new director of Aging and Adult Services on March 25. | A message to social media companies: Follow your own rules to end hate speech The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors passed a resolution I sponsored urging social media platforms such as Facebook and X to enforce their own community standards and guidelines to prevent and eliminate content promoting guns, violence, hate and other content that may be harmful on March 26. My office collaborated with Dr. Karen North, professor of Digital Social Media at the USC Annenberg School on the presentation of the resolution to the Board of Supervisors. The rabbit holes on social media run deep and are filled with content that promotes violence and hate that not only harms children as is widely noted but also adults who find refuge in consuming and spreading hateful and divisive content. Facebook has community standards and says it will remove content that is inauthentic, unsafe or degrading to others but its simply not following its own rules. The consequences of not enforcing these guidelines can lead to violent outcomes and have severe mental health impacts on all of us. Dr. North previously worked in the Clinton Administration in the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, and before that she worked for Rep. Edward Markey, Chairman of the U.S. House of Representatives Subcommittee on Telecommunications and Finance. The Florida Supreme Court just issued a decision to uphold our state's 15-week abortion ban. That means Ron DeSantis' brutal six-week ban with almost no exceptions for rape or incest will automatically take effect in less than 30 days. But they also just ruled to officially put abortion rights on the ballot this November, which means that Florida voters could _overturn_ the GOP's extreme bans. This is a HUGE victory in the fight to defend reproductive freedom — but it's just the beginning. Now, we need to get this initiative across the finish line, defeat Rick Scott at the ballot box, and codify abortion rights.
